/* p671: P34U — the uniforms of the city in one place (the owner 5.11 02:17: "every airline with the uniforms of its cabin crew and its
   pilots; the bus drivers…; all the uniforms the city needs").  Men and boys only.  P34U.dress(L, role, o) puts the uniform of a role on a
   look (keeps the face, the skin, the hair, the height); P34U.l(role, i, o) — a whole look (i — which man); P34U.ROLES — the table.
   The airlines (the names of the code, LIV.pax order, as G77_UNI of p345): the colour of each airline's livery; the second colour is the
   company's accent (tie, pin, cap badge). */
var P34U = (function () {
  'use strict';
  const AIR = [['Aurelia Air', '#1f5aa6', '#0f7a8a', '#d4af37'], ['Sunbeak', '#f6c518', '#f28a1c', '#1b1b1b'], ['Zebrano', '#18181a', '#5b2a86', '#f4f4f4'], ['Coral Coast', '#e2563f', '#0e9aa7', '#f4f4f4'],
    ['Tidewind Air', '#13294b', '#1e5b3a', '#d4af37'], ['Mirage Jet', '#e0218a', '#2b2d42', '#f4f4f4'], ['Confetti Air', '#3a86ff', '#7209b7', '#ffd166'], ['Skyline Regional', '#3a3f8f', '#8a1c2b', '#c9ced3']];
  const sh = (h, k) => '#' + [1, 3, 5].map(i => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16) * k))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  const SKIN = ['#f1c7a5', '#e2b08a', '#d39a72', '#b97c56', '#8d5a3b', '#6a4029'], HAIR = ['#1e1712', '#3b2a1f', '#5a3d26', '#7a5a3a', '#15110e', '#8a8a86'];

  // the airline of a livery index (0…15 → airline i % 8, variant ⌊i / 8⌋), as g77Uniform
  function air(a) { a = (a | 0) % 16; const q = AIR[a % 8], v = a >= 8 ? 1 : 0; return { name: q[0], col: q[1 + v], acc: v ? q[1] : q[2], gold: q[3] } }
  const set = (L, top, legs, shoes) => { L.top = top; L.legs = legs; delete L.socks; if (shoes) L.shoes = shoes; return L };
  const clean = L => { for (const k of ['vest', 'vestK', 'hat', 'badge', 'stripe', 'stripeZ', 'epau', 'apron', 'steth', 'earmuff', 'belt', 'item']) delete L[k]; return L };
  const R = {
    // ---- the airport: every airline's pilots (captain 4 bars, first officer 3) and cabin crew ----
    pilot(L, o) { const A = air(o.a), j = sh(A.col, .62); clean(L); set(L, { t: 'suit', c: j, c2: '#f4f6f8', tie: sh(A.col, .4) }, { t: 'suit', c: '#1b1f2a' }, black);
      L.hat = { t: 'peak', c: j, b: '#121417', e: A.gold }; L.badge = { k: 'wings', c: A.gold, c2: A.acc }; L.epau = { n: o.fo ? 3 : 4, c: A.gold, b: sh(A.col, .45) }; delete L.beard; return L },
    cabin(L, o) { const A = air(o.a); clean(L); set(L, { t: 'suit', c: A.col, c2: '#f4f6f8', tie: A.acc }, { t: 'suit', c: sh(A.col, .55) }, black);
      L.hat = { t: 'garrison', c: A.col, e: A.gold }; L.badge = { k: 'pin', c: A.gold, c2: A.acc }; delete L.beard; return L },
    ground(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'shirt', c: '#2f3e5c', c2: '#2f3e5c', long: true }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#2b3038' }, boots); L.vest = '#ff7a1a'; L.earmuff = '#3c5a44'; delete L.beard; return L },
    // ---- the roads and the rails ----
    bus(L, o) { const lc = o.line || '#2f6fd0'; clean(L); set(L, { t: 'shirt', c: '#a9cbe8', c2: '#c3dbef' }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#1f2a44' }, black);
      L.badge = { k: 'tag', c: lc }; L.belt = '#141414'; if (o.cap) L.hat = { t: 'peak', c: '#1f2a44', b: lc, e: SILVER }; return L },
    train(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'suit', c: '#7a1f2f', c2: '#f3f4f6', tie: '#141414' }, { t: 'suit', c: '#2b2f3a' }, black); L.hat = { t: 'peak', c: '#2b2f3a', b: '#7a1f2f', e: GOLD }; L.badge = { k: 'pin', c: GOLD }; return L },
    station(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'polo', c: '#2b2f3a' }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#2b2f3a' }, black); L.vest = '#f2d21b'; L.badge = { k: 'tag', c: '#7a1f2f' }; return L },
    // ---- the emergency services ----
    police(L, o) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'shirt', c: '#243b63', long: true }, { t: 'trousers', c: NAVY }, black); L.belt = '#141414';
      L.hat = { t: 'peak', c: NAVY, b: '#141414', e: SILVER }; L.badge = { k: 'star', c: SILVER, c2: '#243b63' }; if (o.sgt) L.epau = { n: 3, c: SILVER, b: NAVY }; return L },

    // ---- the services ----
    post(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'polo', c: '#1f4fa8' }, { t: 'shorts', c: '#1f2a44' }, white); L.socks = '#f4f4f4'; L.hat = { t: 'cap', c: '#1f4fa8' }; L.item = { k: 'shoulderbag', c: '#f0b429' }; L.badge = { k: 'pin', c: '#f0b429' }; return L },
    guard(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'shirt', c: '#1f2328', long: true }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#1f2328' }, black); L.belt = '#141414'; L.badge = { k: 'star', c: SILVER, c2: '#1f2328' }; L.epau = { n: 1, c: SILVER, b: '#1f2328' }; return L },
    janitor(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'shirt', c: '#4a6a8a' }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#3a3f4a' }, { t: 'sneaker', c: '#2d3440' }); L.belt = '#2a211b'; L.badge = { k: 'tag', c: '#2e8b57' }; return L },
    // ---- the port, the refinery, the building sites, the parks ----
    logistics(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'polo', c: '#2f3d4c' }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#33404c' }, boots); L.vest = '#14b8a6'; L.hat = { t: 'helmet', c: '#f4f6f8' }; L.badge = { k: 'pin', c: '#14b8a6', c2: '#f4f6f8' }; delete L.beard; return L },   /* p658: עובד לוגיסטיקה — פארק הלוגיסטיקה (D4) */
    dock(L) { clean(L); set(L, { t: 'shirt', c: '#3b5a7a', long: true }, { t: 'trousers', c: '#2b3a4a' }, boots); L.vest = '#ff7a1a'; L.hat = { t: 'helmet', c: '#f2c200' }; return L },

  function l(role, i, o) { i = i | 0; const h = 1.72 + ((i * 37) % 13) / 100, L = { h: +h.toFixed(2), w: 1 + ((i * 7) % 5) / 50, skin: SKIN[(i * 5 + 1) % SKIN.length], hair: { t: (i % 3) === 2 ? 'crop' : 'short', c: HAIR[(i * 3) % HAIR.length] },
    top: { t: 'shirt', c: '#ffffff' }, legs: { t: 'trousers', c: '#2b2f36' }, shoes: { t: 'leather', c: '#141210' } }; if ((i % 4) === 3) L.beard = { c: L.hair.c }; return dress(L, role, o || {}) }
  function dress(L, role, o) { const f = R[role]; return f ? f(L, o || {}) : L }

  const PE = { 21: ['police'], 22: ['police', { sgt: 1 }], 23: ['traffic'], 24: ['fire'], 25: ['fire', { chief: 1 }], 27: ['medic'], 28: ['medic'], 29: ['nurse'], 30: ['doctor'], 31: ['bus'], 32: ['train'], 33: ['station'],

'pilot' : 'cabin', { a: st && st.a != null ? st.a : 4, fo: r && r() < .5 }); if (r && r() < .5) L.item = { k: 'suitcase', c: r() < .5 ? '#141414' : '#2b2f36' }; return L }
    if (!q) return L; const x = Object.assign({}, q[1] || {}); if (n === 31) { x.line = o && o.st && o.st.top || '#2f6fd0'; x.cap = r ? r() < .4 : 0 } if (n === 30) x.gl = r ? r() < .4 : 0; if (n === 54) x.straw = r ? r() < .5 : 0;
    return dress(L, q[0], x) }
  return { AIR, air, ROLES, R, l, dress, role, PE };

const VDG=new Map();
// the geometry of a model: the outline (the half seen on +y, rear → front, dense at the ends), its outward normals, the insets on demand
function vdGeo(m){const id=m[0];let G=VDG.get(id);if(G)return G;
 const[,,ty,L,W,cab,,,wb]=m,D=Object.assign({feat:[]},VD_T[ty]||VD_T.sedan,VD_M[id]||VD_M[String(id).replace(/~F$/,'')]||{}),X=-L/2,H=W/2,N=76,zf=D.zf*L,zr=D.zr*L,xf=L/2-zf,xr=X+zr;
 const tyL=Math.min(.17*L,W*.42),arch=tyL*.78;
 const hb=x=>{let h=H-D.fl;for(const f of wb){const u=(x-(X+f*L))/arch;if(Math.abs(u)<1)h+=D.fl*Math.cos(u*Math.PI/2)**2}
  const tF=Math.max(0,(x-(L/2-zf*1.8))/(zf*1.8)),tR=Math.max(0,((X+zr*1.8)-x)/(zr*1.8));return h*(1-D.tf*tF*tF-D.tr*tR*tR)};
 const hw=x=>{let h=hb(x);if(x>xf){const u=Math.min(1,(x-xf)/zf);h*=Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(u,D.pf)),1/D.pf)}
  if(x<xr){const u=Math.min(1,(xr-x)/zr);h*=Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(u,D.pr)),1/D.pr)}return h};
 // the points along the curve itself: the tail and the nose as superellipse arcs by angle (the flat fronts get points along their edge too), the side between
 const P=[],K=16,NS=N-2*K;for(let k=K;k>=1;k--){const th=Math.PI/2*k/K,u=Math.pow(Math.sin(th),2/D.pr),x=xr-zr*u;P.push([x,hb(x)*Math.pow(Math.cos(th),2/D.pr)])}
 for(let i=0;i<=NS;i++){const x=xr+(xf-xr)*i/NS;P.push([x,hb(x)])}
 for(let k=1;k<=K;k++){const th=Math.PI/2*k/K,u=Math.pow(Math.sin(th),2/D.pf),x=xf+zf*u;P.push([x,hb(x)*Math.pow(Math.cos(th),2/D.pf)])}
 P[0][1]=0;P[N][1]=0;
 const Nm=P.map((p,i)=>{const a=P[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=P[Math.min(N,i+1)],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;return[-dy/l,dx/l]});
 const ins=new Map(),inset=d=>{let q=ins.get(d);if(!q){q=P.map((p,i)=>[p[0]-d*Nm[i][0],Math.max(0,p[1]-d*Nm[i][1])]);ins.set(d,q)}return q};
 // the whole outline as a path (d > 0 — inside, d < 0 — outside)
 const loopB=(t,d)=>{const q=d?inset(d):P;t.moveTo(q[0][0],q[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<=N;i++)t.lineTo(q[i][0],q[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=0;i--)t.lineTo(q[i][0],-q[i][1]);t.closePath()},loop=(c,d)=>{c.beginPath();loopB(c,d)};
 // the paths that are the same in every picture of the model — kept once (Path2D) for the real canvases
 const pc=new Map(),path2=(k,b)=>{let p=pc.get(k);if(!p){p=new Path2D();b(p);pc.set(k,p)}return p};
 // the indices of a stretch of the outline: from x ≥ a, and (near the ends) while |y| ≥ yb
 const fromX=a=>{let i=0;while(i<N&&P[i][0]<a)i++;return i},lastY=(i0,yb)=>{let j=i0;while(j<N&&P[j+1][1]>=yb)j++;return j},firstY=(i1,yb)=>{let j=i1;while(j>0&&P[j-1][1]>=yb)j--;return j};
 // a band along the outline (d0 → d1 inside) on side s, between the indices i0 … i1 (as a closed path)
 const band=(c,s,i0,i1,d0,d1)=>{const a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[i0][0],s*a[i0][1]);for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],s*a[i][1]);for(let i=i1;i>=i0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],s*b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 const line=(c,s,i0,i1,d)=>{const a=inset(d);c.moveTo(a[i0][0],s*a[i0][1]);for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],s*a[i][1])};
 // the front band across the nose (both sides through the middle), for |y| ≤ yb
 const nose=(c,yb,d0,d1)=>{const j=lastY(fromX(L/2-zf),yb)+1,a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[j][0],a[j][1]);for(let i=j+1;i<=N;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],a[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=j;i--)c.lineTo(a[i][0],-a[i][1]);
  for(let i=j;i<=N;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=j;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 const tail=(c,yb,d0,d1)=>{const j=firstY(fromX(X+zr),yb)-1,a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[j][0],a[j][1]);for(let i=j-1;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(a[i][0],a[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],-a[i][1]);
  for(let i=j;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 G={D,P,N,hw,inset,loop,loopB,path2,band,line,nose,tail,fromX,lastY,firstY,tyL,arch,zf,zr};VDG.set(id,G);return G}
// a lamp along the outline at a corner (s = side): f — the front, else the rear; the stretch from x (inside) to |y| = yb at the end
function vdLamp(c,G,s,front,xa,yb,d0,d1,housing,lens,glow){const i0=front?G.fromX(xa):0,i1=front?G.lastY(i0,yb):G.fromX(xa),j0=front?i0:G.firstY(i1,yb);
 if(front){G.band(c,s,i0,i1,d0-.25,d1+.3);c.fillStyle=housing;c.fill();G.band(c,s,i0,i1,d0,d1);c.fillStyle=lens;c.fill();if(glow){c.strokeStyle=glow;c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();G.line(c,s,i0,i1,d0+.3);c.stroke()}}
 else{G.band(c,s,j0,i1,d0-.25,d1+.3);c.fillStyle=housing;c.fill();G.band(c,s,j0,i1,d0,d1);c.fillStyle=lens;c.fill();if(glow){c.strokeStyle=glow;c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();G.line(c,s,j0,i1,d0+.3);c.stroke()}}}
// a point on the outline at the front side where |y| ≈ yv, moved inside by d (for round lamps)
function vdAt(G,front,yv,d){const P=G.P,N=G.N;let i=front?N:0;if(front){while(i>0&&P[i][1]<yv)i--}else{while(i<N&&P[i][1]<yv)i++}const q=G.inset(d)[i];return[q[0],q[1]]}
function veh(c,m,S,t){const[id,,ty,L,W,cab,nf,nr,wb]=m,col=m.fix||PAL[S.c][1],X=-L/2,Y=-W/2,H=W/2,on=k=>S.L[k]!==false,G=vdGeo(m),D=G.D,F=k=>D.feat.includes(k);
c.translate(L/2+10,W/2+10);
const x0=X+cab[0]*L,x1=X+cab[1]*L,cw=W*.78,lng=['suv','mv','van'].includes(ty),r0=lng?X+L*.07:x0+(x1-x0)*.22,r1=x1-(x1-x0)*(ty=='sport'?.4:.3),xm=(x0+x1)/2,sb=D.sb*W,
 bx=ty=='truck'&&!m.fix?'#e9edf1':col,dk='#1c2026',sv='#c9ced4',lux=m.ex=='lux',boxT=ty=='van'||ty=='truck';

// the glass, the roof and the lamps — a far car or a car in a zoom costs a few drawing calls

// the shadow — the outline itself, outside and soft
if(on('shadow')){c.save();c.translate(2.4,3.1);if(lod<2)PF('sh',t=>G.loopB(t,-1.2),'rgba(0,0,0,.11)');PF('b0',t=>G.loopB(t,0),lod<2?'rgba(0,0,0,.17)':'rgba(0,0,0,.24)');c.restore()}
// the tyres: under the body; from above only the edge of the tread shows (a little more on the off-road and the work cars)
if(on('wheels')&&lod==0){const tl=G.tyL,tw=Math.max(3.4,W*.15);c.strokeStyle='#2d3238';c.lineWidth=.5;

  fr(c,'rgba(255,255,255,.07)',x-tl/2+1,d<0?yc-tw/2+.3:yc+tw/2-1.1,tl-2,.8,.4)})})}
if(on('paint')){
 // the body: the sides seen from above (darker), the upper surfaces, the outline
 PF('b0',t=>G.loopB(t,0),bodyG(-.45,-.16));
 if(lod<2)PF('b1',t=>G.loopB(t,sb),lg(c,0,-H,0,H,[sh(col,-.08),sh(col,.12),sh(col,.18),sh(col,.12),sh(col,-.08)]));
 if(lod==0){ // a soft lengthwise light over the upper surfaces and the shoulder lines
 c.save();G.loop(c,sb);c.clip();fr(c,lg(c,X,0,L/2,0,['rgba(0,0,0,.08)','rgba(255,255,255,.07)','rgba(255,255,255,.02)','rgba(0,0,0,.06)']),X,-H,L,W);c.restore();
 c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.22)';c.lineWidth=.55;c.beginPath();{const i0=G.fromX(X+L*.16),i1=G.fromX(L/2-L*.14);G.line(c,1,i0,i1,sb+.5);G.line(c,-1,i0,i1,sb+.5)}c.stroke();
 // the fender arches (the edge of every flare) and the sills between them
 c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.28)';c.lineWidth=.6;c.beginPath();wb.forEach(f=>{const x=X+f*L,i0=G.fromX(x-G.arch*1.05),i1=G.fromX(x+G.arch*1.05);G.line(c,1,i0,i1,.45);G.line(c,-1,i0,i1,.45)});c.stroke()}

 if(ty=='truck'&&lod<2){const a=X+L*.02,b=x0-3;fr(c,'rgba(0,0,0,.25)',a+.6,Y+1.6,b-a,W-2.4,3);fr(c,lg(c,0,Y,0,H,[sh(bx,-.12),sh(bx,.06),sh(bx,-.12)]),a,Y+1,b-a,W-2.2,3);c.strokeStyle=sh(bx,-.18);c.lineWidth=.8;c.beginPath();for(let x=a+L*.06;x<b-4;x+=9){c.moveTo(x,Y+2);c.lineTo(x,H-2.4)}c.stroke();

if(on('glass')){const ws=x1-r1,dw=Math.max(2.5,ws*.3);

const el=(c,f,x,y,rx,ry)=>{c.fillStyle=f;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,Math.max(.1,rx),Math.max(.1,ry),0,0,TAU);c.fill()};
// the fuselage outline: nose ogive (nl = nose length), constant section, tail cone (tl), tail end width k·hw; cockpit kind
function fusPath(c,L,hw,nl,tl,tk){const xn=L/2,xb=xn-nl,xt=-L/2+tl,xe=-L/2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(xn,0);c.bezierCurveTo(xn,hw*.55,xn-nl*.45,hw,xb,hw);c.lineTo(xt,hw);
 c.bezierCurveTo(xt-tl*.45,hw,xe+tl*.08,hw*tk*1.6,xe,hw*tk);c.lineTo(xe,-hw*tk);c.bezierCurveTo(xe+tl*.08,-hw*tk*1.6,xt-tl*.45,-hw,xt,-hw);c.lineTo(xb,-hw);c.bezierCurveTo(xn-nl*.45,-hw,xn,-hw*.55,xn,0);c.closePath()}
function fuselage(c,L,hw,nl,tl,tk,lv,o={}){if(PASS==='d')return;
 fusPath(c,L,hw,nl,tl,tk);c.fillStyle=Q>=3?lv.b:lg(c,0,-hw,0,hw,[sh(lv.b,.12),lv.b,lv.b,sh(lv.b,-.1),sh(lv.u,-.12)]);c.fill();
 if(Q>=3){if(o.tailWrap!==false){c.fillStyle=lv.t;c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*tk*1.2,tl*1.1,hw*tk*2.4)}return}
 c.save();fusPath(c,L,hw,nl,tl,tk);c.clip();
 wrap(c,L,hw,nl,tl,lv,o);   // D-66: the airline's own wrap
 mkBody(c,L,hw,nl,tl,lv);   // D-72: name · model · registration
 c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.3)';c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*.42,L,hw*.2);   // the dorsal light band (cylinder from above)
 if(o.crown!==false&&Q<=1){const big=lv.w==='allover'||lv.w==='spine',col=big?lv.m:lv.s;c.fillStyle=col;c.globalAlpha=.92;for(let i=0;i<(big?5:6);i++)c.fillRect(L/2-nl*1.25-i*L*(big?.03:.022),-hw*(big?.2:.12),L*(big?.022:.016),hw*(big?.4:.24));c.globalAlpha=1}   // the titles on the crown (abstract)
 // panel lines (frames) every ~12 % and a longeron each side
 if(Q===0){c.strokeStyle='rgba(30,40,50,.16)';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,hw*.03);for(let x=-L/2+tl*.9;x<L/2-nl*.6;x+=L*.12){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,-hw);c.lineTo(x,hw);c.stroke()}
 line(c,'rgba(30,40,50,.12)',Math.max(.5,hw*.02),-L/2+tl,-hw*.22,L/2-nl*.4,-hw*.22)}
 c.restore();
 fusPath(c,L,hw,nl,tl,tk);c.strokeStyle='rgba(20,28,36,.55)';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.8,hw*.05);c.stroke()}
// the wrap of an airline (inside the fuselage clip; D-66)
function wrap(c,L,hw,nl,tl,lv,o){const w=lv.w||'classic',x0=-L/2+tl*1.35,tailSec=()=>{if(o.tailWrap===false&&w==='classic')return;c.fillStyle=lv.t;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,-hw);c.quadraticCurveTo(x0-tl*.25,0,x0,hw);c.lineTo(-L/2,hw);c.lineTo(-L/2,-hw);c.closePath();c.fill()},
  mark=()=>{c.fillStyle=lv.m;c.globalAlpha=.85;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x0-tl*.55,0,tl*.18,hw*.42,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.globalAlpha=1};
 if(w==='classic'){if(o.cheat!==false){c.fillStyle=lv.s;c.fillRect(-L/2,hw*.5,L,hw*.24);c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*.74,L,hw*.24)}if(o.tailWrap!==false){tailSec();mark()}return}
 if(w==='allover'){c.fillStyle=lv.s;c.fillRect(-L/2,hw*.62,L,hw*.12);c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*.74,L,hw*.12);tailSec();mark();el(c,lv.s,L/2-nl*.1,0,nl*.38,hw*.95);return}   // the whole body coloured (base fill), dark nose, thin side lines
 if(w==='bands'){c.fillStyle=lv.s;const st=L*.07;for(let x=-L/2-hw;x<L/2-nl*.4;x+=st){P(c,[[x,-hw],[x+L*.028,-hw],[x+L*.028+hw*.9,hw],[x+hw*.9,hw]]);c.fill()}tailSec();c.fillStyle=lv.b;for(let k=0;k<3;k++)c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw+k*hw*.7,tl*1.3,hw*.22);return}   // diagonal stripes across the body, a striped tail
 if(w==='split'){const xs=L*.02;c.fillStyle=lv.t;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(xs+L*.06,-hw);c.bezierCurveTo(xs,-hw*.3,xs+L*.04,hw*.3,xs-L*.04,hw);c.lineTo(-L/2,hw);c.lineTo(-L/2,-hw);c.closePath();c.fill();   // the rear in the airline colour, a curved seam
  c.strokeStyle=lv.s;c.lineWidth=hw*.16;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(xs+L*.06+hw*.2,-hw);c.bezierCurveTo(xs+hw*.2,-hw*.3,xs+L*.04+hw*.2,hw*.3,xs-L*.04+hw*.2,hw);c.stroke();mark();return}
 if(w==='swoosh'){c.fillStyle=lv.s;for(const k of[-1,1]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(L*.38,k*hw);c.bezierCurveTo(L*.12,k*hw*.92,L*.0,k*hw*.25,-L*.16,0);c.lineTo(-L/2,0);c.lineTo(-L/2,k*hw);c.closePath();c.fill()}   // a wave rising from both sides, meeting on the spine and running into the tail
  c.strokeStyle=lv.m;c.lineWidth=hw*.14;for(const k of[-1,1]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(L*.44,k*hw*.98);c.bezierCurveTo(L*.18,k*hw*.86,L*.06,k*hw*.22,-L*.1,k*hw*.02);c.stroke()}tailSec();return}
 if(w==='nose'){c.fillStyle=lv.s;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(L/2-nl*1.15,-hw);c.quadraticCurveTo(L/2-nl*.95,0,L/2-nl*1.15,hw);c.lineTo(L/2,hw);c.lineTo(L/2,-hw);c.closePath();c.fill();   // the coloured nose, a tail and a thin line
  c.fillRect(-L/2,hw*.66,L,hw*.08);c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*.74,L,hw*.08);tailSec();mark();return}
 if(w==='dots'){const D=lv.d||[lv.s,lv.t,lv.m];let i=0;for(let x=-L/2+tl*.3;x<L/2-nl*.6;x+=hw*.9)for(let y=-hw*.8;y<=hw*.8;y+=hw*.55){const r=hw*(.14+.08*((i*7)%3)),dx=((i*13)%5-2)*hw*.06;c.fillStyle=D[i%D.length];c.beginPath();c.arc(x+dx,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill();i++}   // a pattern of dots
  tailSec();mark();return}
 if(w==='spine'){c.fillStyle=lv.s;c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*.46,L-nl*.5,hw*.92);c.fillStyle=lv.m;c.fillRect(-L/2,-hw*.52,L-nl*.5,hw*.08);c.fillRect(-L/2,hw*.44,L-nl*.5,hw*.08);tailSec();return}   // a wide stripe along the spine
}
// a row of cabin windows on each side between u0 and u1 (u from the nose), n windows
function windows(c,L,hw,u0,u1,n,big,skip=[]){if(PASS==='d')return;const ww=hw*(big?.2:.22),wh=hw*(big?.13:.15);c.fillStyle='#22384e';if(Q>=2)return;

// a swept, tapered wing pair: root leading edge xr (at |y| = yr), sweep sw (x offset of the tip leading edge), root chord wc, tip chord tc,
// half span HS; returns the outline per side; fill with a span-wise gradient; flaps / ailerons / slats lines, walkway, winglet
function wingPts(xr,yr,sw,wc,tc,HS,s){return[[xr,s*yr],[xr-sw,s*HS],[xr-sw-tc,s*HS],[xr-wc,s*yr]]}
function wings(c,m,lv,o){if(PASS==='d')return;const{xr,yr,sw,wc,tc,HS}=o,col=o.col||sh(lv.b,-.04);
 for(const s of[-1,1]){const pts=wingPts(xr,yr,sw,wc,tc,HS,s);c.fillStyle=lg(c,xr,0,xr-wc,0,[sh(col,.1),col,sh(col,-.1)]);P(c,pts);c.fill();if(Q<=2)S_(c,'rgba(20,28,36,.45)',Math.max(.7,yr*.04),pts,true);
  // the trailing-edge devices: flaps (inner 60 %), aileron (outer), the slats line along the leading edge
  const te=f=>[xr-wc+(wc-tc-sw)*f*0+(-(sw+tc)+wc)*f*0,0];const tx=f=>(xr-wc)+((xr-sw-tc)-(xr-wc))*f,ty=f=>s*(yr+(HS-yr)*f),lx=f=>xr+((xr-sw)-xr)*f;
  if(Q<=1){c.strokeStyle='rgba(30,40,50,.35)';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,yr*.03);c.beginPath();for(const f of[.05,.35,.62,.9]){const ch=wc+(tc-wc)*f,x=tx(f)+ch*.22,y=ty(f);c.moveTo(x,y-s*.1);c.lineTo(tx(f),y)}c.stroke();
  c.beginPath();c.moveTo(tx(.03)+wc*.2,ty(.03));c.lineTo(tx(.62)+(wc+(tc-wc)*.62)*.2,ty(.62));c.lineTo(tx(.95)+tc*.24,ty(.95));c.stroke()}   // flap / aileron hinge line
  if(Q===0){c.setLineDash([HS*.025,HS*.02]);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(lx(.08)-wc*.08,ty(.08));c.lineTo(lx(.92)-tc*.1,ty(.92));c.stroke();c.setLineDash([]);   // slats
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(30,30,30,.22)';c.setLineDash([yr*.12,yr*.1]);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(lx(.04)-wc*.35,ty(.04));c.lineTo(lx(.22)-(wc+(tc-wc)*.22)*.35,ty(.22));c.stroke();c.setLineDash([])}   // walkway
  if(o.winglet){const wx=xr-sw-tc*.15,wy=s*HS;F(c,lv.t,[[wx,wy],[wx-tc*.9,wy+s*HS*.012],[wx-tc*1.05,wy+s*HS*.03],[wx-tc*.2,wy+s*HS*.03]])}
  if(o.fairing&&s>0&&!o.high&&Q<=1){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.5;F(c,sh(col,-.06),[[xr+wc*.08,-yr*1.12],[xr-wc*1.15,-yr*1.12],[xr-wc*1.15,yr*1.12],[xr+wc*.08,yr*1.12]]);c.restore()}   // the wing-root fairing (seen beside the fuselage)
  if(o.fuel){const fx=o.fuel[0],fy=s*Math.abs(o.fuel[1]);hatch(c,fx,fy,HS*.012)}}}

// lights: nav red (port, −y), green (starboard, +y), white tail; beacon (red, on the spine) and strobes (wing tips) blink when not parked-off
function lights(c0,lv,tipL,tipR,tail,spine,fw,t,st){dyn(c0,c=>{const on=st>0||t===0,b=st>0&&t>0&&(t*1.1)%1<.5,s=st>=2&&t>0&&(t*1.7)%1<.08,r=fw*.06;

// the tail mark on the fin / on the fuselage near the tail (fictional logos: arc, bird, sun, stripes, leaf, chevron, wave, star)
function logo(c,lv,x,y,s){if(PASS==='d')return;if(Q>1)return;c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.fillStyle=lv.m;c.strokeStyle=lv.m;c.lineWidth=s*.16;switch(lv.k){
 case'arc':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,s*.5,-.4,3.5);c.stroke();break;case'bird':P(c,[[s*.5,0],[-s*.4,-s*.4],[-s*.15,0],[-s*.4,s*.4]]);c.fill();break;
 case'sun':ci(c,0,0,s*.32,lv.m);break;case'stripes':for(const k of[-1,0,1])c.fillRect(-s*.45,k*s*.24-s*.06,s*.9,s*.12);break;

/* ---------- TREES & PLANTS (strictly plan view) ---------- */
(()=>{
const prev=tree;
const shadowBlob=(c,cx,cy,rx,ry,k)=>{c.fillStyle=TD.SH;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(cx+k,cy+k,rx,ry,.6,0,6.3);c.fill()};
tree=function(c,m,S,t){const s=m.s,cx=s/2,cy=s/2,[a,b]=m.col&&S.v==0?m.col:TP[0][S.v],r=rnd((m.sd||3)+11),ty=m.t,sw=FX?Math.sin(t*1.3)*.7:0;

/* ---------- p354 · stage 7 part 5 — the nature kit at the design level of the new world (plan view; light from the upper-left) ---------- */
(()=>{

// ---- geometry audit ----
function d4GeometryAudit(){   /* p477: D4 של המפה */
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,inside=(a,b)=>a.x>=b.x&&a.y>=b.y&&a.x+a.w<=b.x+b.w&&a.y+a.h<=b.y+b.h;
 const fp=D4_BUILDINGS.map(b=>({id:b.id,x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h}));
 const rw=EDGES.map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],t=roadType(e),h=t.width/2+t.sidewalk;return{id:e.id,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+2*h,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+2*h}}).filter(r=>over(r,D4_BOX));
 const corr=[];   /* p490: המסדרון של הסמי — semiSweptAudit (שני הגופים, כל 2 פיקס׳) */
 const corrHit=r=>{for(const c of corr)if(circleRectHit(c.x,c.y,14,r))return c.ref;return null};
 for(const f of fp){if(!inside(f,D4_BOX))issues.push(f.id+':bounds');for(const r of rw)if(over(f,r))issues.push(f.id+':road:'+r.id);const c=f.id==='D4-DC'?null:corrHit(f);if(c)issues.push(f.id+':semi-corridor:'+c)}
 for(let i=0;i<fp.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fp.length;j++)if(over(fp[i],fp[j]))issues.push('overlap:'+fp[i].id+'/'+fp[j].id);
 for(const s of D4_SOLIDS){if(/^C4-/.test(s.id))continue;const fence=/^D4-F-/.test(s.id);for(const r of rw)if(!fence&&over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id);const c=corrHit(s);if(c)issues.push(s.id+':semi-corridor:'+c);for(const a of C4_ACCESS)if(/^D4-CUT-/.test(a.id)&&over(s,a))issues.push(s.id+':cut:'+a.id)}
 for(const s of D4_STAFF_STALLS){for(const f of fp)if(over(s,f))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const r of rw)if(over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id);const c=corrHit(s);if(c)issues.push(s.id+':semi-corridor:'+c)}
 for(const o of PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>/^PC-D4-/.test(o.id)))if(!o.slotRect||!D4_STAFF_STALLS.some(s=>s.x===o.slotRect.x&&s.y===o.slotRect.y))issues.push(o.id+':not-in-stall');
 for(const p of Object.values(D4_INTERACTIONS)){for(const f of fp)if(over({x:p.x-4,y:p.y-4,w:8,h:8},f))issues.push(p.id+':poi-in-building:'+f.id)}
 for(const b of D4_TRAILER_BAYS){const r={x:b.x+8,y:b.y+4,w:b.w-12,h:b.h-8};for(const f of fp)if(over(r,f))issues.push(b.id+':building:'+f.id)}
 const program=D4_BUILDINGS.length===5&&D4_CONTAINERS.length>=4&&D4_STAFF_STALLS.length+(typeof FX3!=='undefined'?FX3.stalls.filter(s=>/^D4-ST-/.test(s[1]||'')).length:0)>=10&&   /* FIX3 · D‑558: החניות שמול הסוכה של ST-12 התבטלו */D4_EQUIPMENT.length===3&&D4_FENCE_SEGS.length>=5&&D4_PARKED_COUNT()>=5&&D4_TRAILER_BAYS.length===5;
 if(!program)issues.push('program-incomplete');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,14),issueCount:issues.length,containers:D4_CONTAINERS.length,stalls:D4_STAFF_STALLS.length,cars:D4_PARKED_COUNT(),trees:D4ND.trees.length,lights:D4ND.lamps.length,props:D4_PROPS.length,solids:D4_SOLIDS.length,fence:D4_FENCE_SEGS.length}
}
function D4_PARKED_COUNT(){return PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>/^PC-D4-/.test(o.id)).length}

function d4MissionReach(){const out=[],yards=[...C4_YARDS.filter(y=>/^D4-/.test(y.id)),...C4_ACCESS.filter(a=>/^D4-/.test(a.id))];

 return out}

function d4Line(P,x0,y0,x1,y1,h,v){const L=Math.hypot(x1-x0,y1-y0),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/6));for(let i=P.length?1:0;i<=n;i++){const t=i/n;P.push({x:x0+(x1-x0)*t,y:y0+(y1-y0)*t,h,v})}}
function d4Arc(P,cx,cy,R,a0,a1,rev,v){const n=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(Math.abs(a1-a0)*R/6)),sg=a1>a0?1:-1;for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){const a=a0+(a1-a0)*i/n,dx=-Math.sin(a)*sg,dy=Math.cos(a)*sg;P.push({x:cx+R*Math.cos(a),y:cy+R*Math.sin(a),h:Math.atan2(rev?-dy:dy,rev?-dx:dx),v})}}
function d4Cum(P){let d=0;P[0].d=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){d+=Math.hypot(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].y-P[i-1].y);P[i].d=d}return P}

/* p490 · the semi as two bodies — the tractor and the trailer, each at its own angle, on ONE path (the owner 2.11 10:12):
   the front at s, the fifth wheel (hitch) at s − a, the trailer's rear axle at s − a − wb (distance along the path; each body is the chord
   between its points). Forward on the road the path is the trail of the front; in the D4 yard — the planned path of the front (also in reverse).
   Real size, 10 px/m (the owner, 2.11 10:26): 16.5 m over all, the trailer LV-TL-01 13.6 m, 2.55 m wide. a — 0.73 of the tractor (the 3/4 kit). */
var SEMI_ART={on:true,L:165,W:25.5,Lt:49.5,a:36.135,kf:7.135,Ltr:136,wb:80,trailMax:360,step:2,pad:1,trails:new Map(),n:0,routes:[]};   // routes: more semi routes for semiSweptAudit (S6: the tanker)
function saCum(P){let d=0;P[0].d=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){d+=Math.hypot(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].y-P[i-1].y);P[i].d=d}return P}
// a point at distance s along P (P[i].d ascending); before the start / after the end — along the first / the last direction
function saAt(P,s){const n=P.length;if(n<2)return{x:P[0].x,y:P[0].y};
 if(s<=P[0].d){const a=P[0];let j=1;while(j<n-1&&P[j].d-a.d<1)j++;const b=P[j],L=Math.max(1e-6,b.d-a.d),t=(s-a.d)/L;return{x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t}}
 const E=P[n-1];if(s>=E.d){let j=n-2;while(j>0&&E.d-P[j].d<1)j--;const a=P[j],L=Math.max(1e-6,E.d-a.d),t=(s-E.d)/L;return{x:E.x+(E.x-a.x)*t,y:E.y+(E.y-a.y)*t}}
 let lo=0,hi=n-1;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(P[m].d<s)lo=m;else hi=m}const a=P[lo],b=P[hi],t=b.d>a.d?(s-a.d)/(b.d-a.d):0;return{x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t}}
// the pose: F the front, H the hitch, A the rear axle, R the trailer's rear end; hc / ht the two headings; c / h — the rigid equivalent (F–R)
function saPoseFrom(F,H,A,o){const G=SEMI_ART;o=o||{};o.fx=F.x;o.fy=F.y;o.hx=H.x;o.hy=H.y;o.ax=A.x;o.ay=A.y;o.hc=Math.atan2(F.y-H.y,F.x-H.x);o.ht=Math.atan2(H.y-A.y,H.x-A.x);
 const k=G.Ltr-G.kf;o.rx=H.x-Math.cos(o.ht)*k;o.ry=H.y-Math.sin(o.ht)*k;o.cx=(F.x+o.rx)/2;o.cy=(F.y+o.ry)/2;o.h=Math.atan2(F.y-o.ry,F.x-o.rx);return o}
function saPoseOn(P,s,o){const G=SEMI_ART;return saPoseFrom(saAt(P,s),saAt(P,s-G.a),saAt(P,s-G.a-G.wb),o)}
// the two rectangles [cx, cy, heading, length, width]: the tractor (front … Lt back) and the trailer (kf ahead of the hitch … Ltr)
function saRects(o){const G=SEMI_ART,c=Math.cos(o.hc),n=Math.sin(o.hc),k=Math.cos(o.ht),m=Math.sin(o.ht),u=G.kf-G.Ltr/2;
 return[[o.fx-c*G.Lt/2,o.fy-n*G.Lt/2,o.hc,G.Lt,G.W],[o.hx+k*u,o.hy+m*u,o.ht,G.Ltr,G.W]]}
// the trail of the front (the road, the port): forward — the front's points; in reverse — wound back along the same trail
function saTrailPose(key,fx,fy,h,o){const G=SEMI_ART;let T=G.trails.get(key);
 if(!T||Math.hypot(fx-T.P[T.P.length-1].x,fy-T.P[T.P.length-1].y)>60){const c=Math.cos(h),n=Math.sin(h);T={P:[{x:fx-c*300,y:fy-n*300,d:0},{x:fx,y:fy,d:300}]};if(G.trails.size>400)G.trails.delete(G.trails.keys().next().value);G.trails.set(key,T)}
 const P=T.P;let L=P[P.length-1];const dx=fx-L.x,dy=fy-L.y,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);let s=L.d;
 if(dd>.01){const Q=P[P.length-2],ux=L.x-Q.x,uy=L.y-Q.y;
  if(dx*ux+dy*uy<0){while(P.length>2){const Q2=P[P.length-2];if((fx-Q2.x)*(P[P.length-1].x-Q2.x)+(fy-Q2.y)*(P[P.length-1].y-Q2.y)>0)break;P.pop()}   // reverse: unwind
   const Q2=P[P.length-2];L=P[P.length-1];L.x=fx;L.y=fy;L.d=Q2.d+Math.hypot(fx-Q2.x,fy-Q2.y);s=L.d}
  else if(dd>=G.step){P.push({x:fx,y:fy,d:L.d+dd});s=L.d+dd}else s=L.d+dd}
 if(P.length>8&&s-P[1].d>G.trailMax){let k=1;while(k<P.length-3&&s-P[k+1].d>G.trailMax)k++;P.splice(0,k)}

// a trail set from a planned path (the D4 yard → the road): the points up to s, then the road goes on from them

// two articulated semis: the four rectangle pairs (separating axes), 1.8 px apart
function saObbHit(a,b,pad){const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];if(Math.abs(dx)>(a[3]+b[3])/2+pad+30||Math.abs(dy)>(a[3]+b[3])/2+pad+30)return false;const ca=Math.cos(a[2]),sa=Math.sin(a[2]),cb=Math.cos(b[2]),sb=Math.sin(b[2]);
 for(const [ux,uy] of [[ca,sa],[-sa,ca],[cb,sb],[-sb,cb]]){const p=Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy),ra=a[3]/2*Math.abs(ca*ux+sa*uy)+a[4]/2*Math.abs(-sa*ux+ca*uy),rb=b[3]/2*Math.abs(cb*ux+sb*uy)+b[4]/2*Math.abs(-sb*ux+cb*uy);if(p>=ra+rb+pad)return false}return true}

function d2HideAudit(){const X=D2X,K=X.K,issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a[0]<b[2]&&a[2]>b[0]&&a[1]<b[3]&&a[3]>b[1];
 const roads=EDGES.filter(e=>/^TC-(D2|C2|D1)-/.test(e.globalRoadId)||['D2-LCN3','D2-MALL'].includes(e.id)).map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],t=roadType(e),h=t.width/2+(t.sidewalk||20);if(e.id==='D2-LCH1')return[e.id,[4220,800,4310,866]];   /* p688: the slant inside the circle — the throat as drawn */return[e.id,[Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,Math.max(a.x,b.x)+h,Math.max(a.y,b.y)+h]]});
 const flat=[...D2_PARKING.map(p=>[p.id,[p.x,p.y,p.x+p.w,p.y+p.h]]),...D2_STALLS.map(s=>[s.id,[s.x,s.y,s.x+s.w,s.y+s.h]]),['D2-ARC-01',X.arc01],['D2-PLAZA-03',X.plaza03],['D2-PLAZA-HQ',X.plaza2],['D2-POOL',X.pool],['D2-YARD',[3960,1340,4160,1440]],['D2-BIKES',X.ne]];
 for(const [k,R] of X.box){const H=K*X.hgt[k],shade=[R[0],R[1]-H,R[2],R[1]];for(const [id,q] of [...roads,...flat])if(over(shade,q))issues.push(k+' hides '+id)}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues}}
function d2GeometryAudit(){const X=D2X,issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,inside=(a,b)=>a.x>=b.x&&a.y>=b.y&&a.x+a.w<=b.x+b.w&&a.y+a.h<=b.y+b.h,box=D2_BOX;
 const fp=X.box.map(([k,R])=>({id:k,x:R[0],y:R[1],w:R[2]-R[0],h:R[3]-R[1]}));
 const rw=EDGES.filter(e=>/^TC-D2-/.test(e.globalRoadId)).map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],h=roadType(e).width/2;return{id:e.id,sw:Math.min(18,roadType(e).sidewalk||18),x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+2*h,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+2*h}});
 const grow=(r,g)=>({x:r.x-g,y:r.y-g,w:r.w+2*g,h:r.h+2*g});
 for(const f of fp){if(!inside(f,box)&&f.id!=='tower')issues.push(f.id+':bounds');for(const r of rw)if(over(f,grow(r,r.sw)))issues.push(f.id+':road-or-sidewalk:'+r.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<fp.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fp.length;j++)if(over(fp[i],fp[j]))issues.push('building-overlap:'+fp[i].id+'/'+fp[j].id);
 for(const p of D2_PARKING){for(const f of fp)if(over(p,f))issues.push(p.id+':building:'+f.id)}
 for(const s of D2_STALLS){if(!D2_PARKING.some(p=>inside(s,p)))issues.push(s.id+':outside-lot');for(const f of fp)if(over(s,f))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const r of rw)if(over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<D2_STALLS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<D2_STALLS.length;j++)if(over(D2_STALLS[i],D2_STALLS[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+D2_STALLS[i].id+'/'+D2_STALLS[j].id);
 for(const a of D2_ACCESS){const touchesRoad=rw.some(r=>over(grow(a,2),r)),touchesLot=D2_PARKING.some(l=>over(grow(a,2),l));if(!touchesRoad)issues.push(a.id+':no-road');if(!touchesLot)issues.push(a.id+':no-lot');for(const f of fp)if(over(a,f))issues.push(a.id+':building:'+f.id)}
 for(const l of D2_LIGHTS){const q={x:l.x-5,y:l.y-5,w:10,h:10};for(const r of rw)if(over(q,r))issues.push(l.id+':road');for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(l.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const s of D2_STALLS)if(over(q,s))issues.push(l.id+':stall:'+s.id)}
 for(const b of D2_BUILDINGS){const q={x:b.entrance.x-6,y:b.entrance.y-6,w:12,h:12};for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(b.id+':poi-in-building:'+f.id);for(const s of D2_STALLS)if(over(q,s))issues.push(b.id+':poi-in-stall:'+s.id)}
 const hide=d2HideAudit();for(const h of hide.issues)issues.push('3/4: '+h);
 const stalls={H1:D2_STALLS.filter(s=>/^D2-H[NS]-/.test(s.id)).length,H2:D2_STALLS.filter(s=>/^D2-CP-/.test(s.id)).length,S:D2_STALLS.filter(s=>/^D2-P[AB]-/.test(s.id)).length};
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,16),issueCount:issues.length,buildings:fp.length,lots:D2_PARKING.length,stalls,cars:D2_CAR_PLAN.length,trees:D2_TREES.length,props:D2X.kit.length,lights:D2_LIGHTS.length,hedges:0,drives:D2_ACCESS.length,hide}}
function nearbyD2Poi(maxDist=105){if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||currentActorChunk()!=='D2')return null;let best=null;for(const p of Object.values(D2_INTERACTIONS)){if(p.noF||p.shop)continue;const b=D2_BUILDINGS.find(q=>q.id===p.id),r=Math.min(maxDist,(b&&b.fR)||maxDist),d=Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-p.x,PlayerPed.y-p.y);if(d<=r&&(!best||d<best.d))best={...p,d}}return best}

function e3RoadHit(r,extra=0){const over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w-.01&&a.x+a.w>b.x+.01&&a.y<b.y+b.h-.01&&a.y+a.h>b.y+.01;
 return EDGES.find(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],h=roadType(e).width/2+extra,horiz=Math.abs(a.y-b.y)<.01;return over(r,{x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-(horiz?0:h),y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-(horiz?h:0),w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+(horiz?0:h*2),h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+(horiz?h*2:0)})})||
  NODES.find(n=>incident(n.id).length>1&&circleRectHit(n.x,n.y,Math.max(...incident(n.id).map(e=>roadType(e).width/2+Math.min(extra,roadType(e).sidewalk??extra))),r))||null}   /* S16: המדרכה של הדרך עצמה (main0 — 1.2 מ׳), לא יותר מ-extra */
function e3GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w-.01&&a.x+a.w>b.x+.01&&a.y<b.y+b.h-.01&&a.y+a.h>b.y+.01,inside=(a,b)=>a.x>=b.x-.01&&a.y>=b.y-.01&&a.x+a.w<=b.x+b.w+.01&&a.y+a.h<=b.y+b.h+.01,

 /* ================= ספינות המכמורת במזרח ================= */
 function trawlScript(T){const L=[];let t=0;const push=o=>{o.t0=t;L.push(o);t+=o.dur};const [x0,y0,x1,y1]=T.box,n=T.rows,ys=[];for(let k=0;k<n;k++)ys.push(y0+(y1-y0)*k/Math.max(1,n-1));
  const seq=n>2?[0,1,2,1]:[0,1],loop=[];for(let i=0;i<seq.length;i++){const y=ys[seq[i]],west=i%2===0,a=west?[x1,y]:[x0,y],b=west?[x0,y]:[x1,y];loop.push(a,b);
   const ny=ys[seq[(i+1)%seq.length]],ex=west?x0-170:x1+170;loop.push(...bez(b,[ex,(y+ny)/2],[west?x0:x1,ny],10).slice(1,-1))}loop.push([x1,y0]);
  const LP=mk(loop),ey=T.edge[1],ent=mk([[T.edge[0],ey],[9800,ey],...bez([9800,ey],[9500,y0],[x1,y0],12).slice(1)]),ext=mk(ent.P.slice().reverse());
  const V_T=36,V_E=90,lpD=LP.len/V_T,tA=T.in,tS=tA+ent.len/V_E,k=Math.max(1,Math.floor((T.out-tS)/lpD));
  push({k:'stay',dur:tA,at:[T.edge[0],ey,PI],mode:'away'});
  push({k:'move',dur:ent.len/V_E,R:ent,mode:'in',ease:.05});
  for(let i=0;i<k;i++)push({k:'move',dur:lpD,R:LP,mode:'trawl',ease:.01});
  push({k:'move',dur:ext.len/V_E,R:ext,mode:'out',ease:.05});
  push({k:'stay',dur:Math.max(1,1440-t),at:[T.edge[0],ey,0],mode:'away'});return L}

 function gull(c,x,y,h,z,fl,N){const s=1.5,K=z*6,sx=x+z*2.5,sy=y+z*3.2,sp=1-.28*Math.max(0,Math.sin(fl)),lift=Math.sin(fl)*1.2;

  for(const sd of[-1,1]){const W=[[1.4,sd*.9],[2.1,sd*5.4*sp],[-2.2,sd*11*sp],[-.9,sd*5.1*sp],[-1.7,sd*.9]].map(q=>P(q[0],q[1]));W[1][1]-=lift;W[2][1]-=lift*1.6;W[3][1]-=lift;
   c.fillStyle=shade('#b9c3cc',1,N);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(W[0][0],W[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<5;i++)c.lineTo(W[i][0],W[i][1]);c.closePath();c.fill();
   c.strokeStyle=shade('#eef1f3',1,N);c.lineWidth=.7;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(W[0][0],W[0][1]);c.lineTo(W[1][0],W[1][1]);c.lineTo(W[2][0],W[2][1]);c.stroke();
   const t1=P(-1.2,sd*8.6*sp),t2=P(-.3,sd*8*sp);t1[1]-=lift*1.4;t2[1]-=lift*1.3;c.fillStyle=shade('#1f2326',1,N);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(W[2][0],W[2][1]);c.lineTo(t1[0],t1[1]);c.lineTo(t2[0],t2[1]);c.closePath();c.fill()}
  c.fillStyle=shade('#f7f8f9',1,N);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,Y,4.6*s,1.5*s,h,0,TAU);c.fill();const hd=P(4.2,0),bk=P(5.9,0),tl=P(-4.4,0);c.beginPath();c.arc(hd[0],hd[1],1.25*s,0,TAU);c.fill();
  c.strokeStyle='#e0a020';c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(hd[0],hd[1]);c.lineTo(bk[0],bk[1]);c.stroke();c.fillStyle=shade('#e6e9ec',1,N);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(tl[0],tl[1]);c.lineTo(P(-3.2,1.2)[0],P(-3.2,1.2)[1]);c.lineTo(P(-3.2,-1.2)[0],P(-3.2,-1.2)[1]);c.closePath();c.fill()}

function s15PoseLeg(g,t){if(g.h!=null)return[g.p[0][0],g.p[0][1],g.h,0,g.f];const T0=g.t1-g.t0,u=t-g.t0,acc=(g.v1-g.v0)/Math.max(1e-6,T0),d=g.v0*u+.5*acc*u*u,P=g.p;let L=0;

// ==== RAIL NETWORK MODEL (data only: ready for train service once E6 opens) — v1.65 integrated yard =========================
// The yard throat is built from smooth S-curve turnouts (cosine easing: tangent to the parent track at both ends) instead of straight
// 45-degree ladders. Three yard tracks (48 px apart, x 5746 / 5698 / 5650) run from the depot doors southwards; Y1 continues as the
// port spur, Y2 and Y3 are stub tracks that end at buffer stops. Main A feeds the yard through a lead at each end.
// Nodes are the points where the geometry changes (boundaries, turnouts, door stubs, buffer stops). Segments are polylines in the travel
// direction of the segment; dir:'fwd' means one-way from->to, dir:'both' means a yard/spur track that can be used either way.
function e5SCurve(x0,y0,x1,y1,n=28){const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const t=i/n,e=t*t*t*(t*(t*6-15)+10);pts.push([+(x0+(x1-x0)*e).toFixed(3),+(y0+(y1-y0)*t).toFixed(3)])}pts[0]=[x0,y0];pts[n]=[x1,y1];return pts}
function rlCubicS(x0,y0,x1,y1,n=34){const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const t=i/n,e=t*t*(3-2*t);pts.push([+(x0+(x1-x0)*e).toFixed(3),+(y0+(y1-y0)*t).toFixed(3)])}pts[0]=[x0,y0];pts[n]=[x1,y1];return pts}

// ==== v1.78 PORT RAIL: E6 + D6 + C6 =====================================================================================================
// The three tracks that stopped at the E5/E6 boundary now continue into the port:
//  · Main A (x 5800, southbound) and main B (x 5900, northbound) run on to the Port Halt (island platform between the two tracks). A crossover
//    north of the platform lets a train that arrived on A reverse onto B and go back to the yard; the platform tracks end at buffer stops.
//  · GATE-75 (RAIL-02/03): the quay siding lies at y 5120, 80 px from the quay edge (y 5200), flush in the apron under the crane span
//    (landside crane rail y 5038, waterside crane rail y 5192) and runs through E6, D6 and C6 to a buffer stop in C6. Main A reaches it on a
//    R 400 arc (END-A (5800,4720) -> Q-E (5400,5120)); main B is joined from the east line by a symmetric R 400 arc (B-J (6300,5120)).
//    Roads never cross a track (every port road ends at the quay road y 4960).
function portArc(cx,cy,r,a0,a1,n=18){const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const t=a0+(a1-a0)*i/n;pts.push([+(cx+r*Math.cos(t)).toFixed(3),+(cy+r*Math.sin(t)).toFixed(3)])}pts[0]=[cx+r*Math.cos(a0),cy+r*Math.sin(a0)];pts[n]=[cx+r*Math.cos(a1),cy+r*Math.sin(a1)];return pts}

// stop. The quay line continues east as a straight line to the coast, over the sea on a bridge and out of the world; main B is joined from that
// line by a R 200 link, so a train can go quay -> bridge -> main B -> north.

// Position and heading (radians, 0 = east, PI/2 = south) at distance s along a segment, travel direction from->to.
function railPointAt(segId,s){const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[segId];if(!g)return null;s=Math.max(0,Math.min(g.len,s));let i=1;while(i<g.pts.length-1&&g.cum[i]<s)i++;const a=g.pts[i-1],b=g.pts[i],l=g.cum[i]-g.cum[i-1]||1,t=(s-g.cum[i-1])/l;return{x:a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,y:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,heading:Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0])}}
// Shortest path over the directed graph (BFS by segment count). Returns [{seg,sign}] or null; sign -1 = against the stored direction.
function railRoute(fromNode,toNode){if(fromNode===toNode)return[];const prev=new Map([[fromNode,null]]),q=[fromNode];while(q.length){const n=q.shift();for(const s of RAIL_SEGS){const fw=s.from===n,bw=s.to===n&&s.dir==='both';if(!fw&&!bw)continue;const m=fw?s.to:s.from;if(prev.has(m))continue;prev.set(m,{n,seg:s.id,sign:fw?1:-1});if(m===toNode){const out=[];let c=m;while(prev.get(c)){const p=prev.get(c);out.unshift({seg:p.seg,sign:p.sign});c=p.n}return out}q.push(m)}}return null}

// ---- Geometry, purpose and rail-network audit ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/* S9 · S7F268: e5RoadRects ו-e5GeometryAudit הישנות יצאו — החדשה ב-019b */
function railNetAudit(){
 const issues=[];const near=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])<.6;
 for(const n of RAIL_NODES){if(!n.port&&!n.line&&(n.x<4800||n.x>6000||n.y<3400||n.y>4250))issues.push(n.id+':outside-chunk')}
 for(const s of RAIL_SEGS){const a=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[s.from],b=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[s.to];if(!a||!b){issues.push(s.id+':missing-node');continue}if(!near(s.pts[0],[a.x,a.y]))issues.push(s.id+':start-mismatch');if(!near(s.pts[s.pts.length-1],[b.x,b.y]))issues.push(s.id+':end-mismatch');if(s.len<12)issues.push(s.id+':too-short:'+s.len.toFixed(1))}
 const seen=new Set();for(const s of RAIL_SEGS){if(seen.has(s.id))issues.push(s.id+':duplicate');seen.add(s.id)}
 // every node is touched by at least one segment; a turnout touches at least three
 for(const n of RAIL_NODES){const deg=RAIL_SEGS.filter(s=>s.from===n.id||s.to===n.id).length;if(!deg)issues.push(n.id+':isolated');if(n.type==='turnout'&&deg<3)issues.push(n.id+':turnout-degree:'+deg)}
 // parallel track spacing: sample straight yard segments, keep >= 42 px between different tracks away from junctions
 const straight=RAIL_SEGS.filter(s=>s.pts.length===2&&s.pts[0][0]===s.pts[1][0]);
 for(const a of straight)for(const b of straight){if(a.id>=b.id||a.pts[0][0]===b.pts[0][0])continue;const dx=Math.abs(a.pts[0][0]-b.pts[0][0]);const y0=Math.max(Math.min(a.pts[0][1],a.pts[1][1]),Math.min(b.pts[0][1],b.pts[1][1])),y1=Math.min(Math.max(a.pts[0][1],a.pts[1][1]),Math.max(b.pts[0][1],b.pts[1][1]));if(y1-y0>24&&dx<42)issues.push('spacing:'+a.id+'/'+b.id+':'+dx)}
 // turnouts are smooth S-curves: tangent to the parent track at both ends, never steeper than 42 degrees, long enough to read as a turnout
 for(const g of RAIL_SEGS.filter(g=>g.kind==='ladder'||g.kind==='lead')){const p=g.pts,n=p.length;if(n<10){issues.push(g.id+':not-a-curve');continue}const a0=Math.abs(Math.atan2(p[1][1]-p[0][1],p[1][0]-p[0][0])-Math.PI/2),a1=Math.abs(Math.atan2(p[n-1][1]-p[n-2][1],p[n-1][0]-p[n-2][0])-Math.PI/2);if(a0>.025||a1>.025)issues.push(g.id+':rail-seam-angle');let mx=0;for(let i=1;i<n;i++)mx=Math.max(mx,Math.abs(Math.atan2(p[i][0]-p[i-1][0],p[i][1]-p[i-1][1])));if(mx>.74)issues.push(g.id+':too-steep:'+(mx*57.3).toFixed(0));if(g.len<100)issues.push(g.id+':too-short-for-turnout:'+g.len.toFixed(0))}
 // every yard track point (bed 40 px wide) lies inside the fenced rail zones
 for(const g of RAIL_SEGS.filter(g=>g.yard))for(const q of g.pts)for(const dx of[-20,0,20])if(!E5_RAIL_ZONES.some(z=>q[0]+dx>=z.x&&q[0]+dx<=z.x+z.w&&q[1]>=z.y&&q[1]<=z.y+z.h)){issues.push(g.id+':outside-rail-zone:'+q[0].toFixed(0)+','+q[1].toFixed(0));break}
 // stock stands on straight track, inside the segment, clear of every turnout and of other stock
 const fpOf=o=>{const I=TurboCity.info(o.asset,{scale:railStockScale(o.asset)});return I.fp[2]};
 for(const o of RAIL_STOCK){const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[o.seg];if(!g){issues.push(o.id+':no-seg');continue}if(g.pts.length!==2)issues.push(o.id+':on-curve');const half=fpOf(o)/2;if(o.s-half<0||o.s+half>g.len)issues.push(o.id+':beyond-segment');for(const [nid,at] of[[g.from,0],[g.to,g.len]]){const nn=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[nid];if(nn&&(nn.type==='turnout'||nn.type==='joint')&&Math.abs(o.s-at)-half<45)issues.push(o.id+':too-close-to-'+nid)}}
 for(let i=0;i<RAIL_STOCK.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<RAIL_STOCK.length;j++){const a=RAIL_STOCK[i],b=RAIL_STOCK[j];if(a.seg!==b.seg)continue;if(Math.abs(a.s-b.s)<(fpOf(a)+fpOf(b))/2+4)issues.push('stock-overlap:'+a.id+'/'+b.id)}
 // connectors: unique ids, node on the chunk boundary, status valid
 for(const c of RAIL_CONNECTORS){const n=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[c.node];if(!n){issues.push(c.id+':no-node');continue}const onB=c.boundary==='N'?n.y===E5_BOX.y:n.y===E5_BOX.y+E5_BOX.h;if(!onB)issues.push(c.id+':not-on-boundary');if(n.x-E5_BOX.x!==c.offset)issues.push(c.id+':offset:'+(n.x-E5_BOX.x));if(!['live','locked'].includes(c.status))issues.push(c.id+':status')}
 // routing proofs (what future train service needs)
 const need=[['RB-A-S','END-A'],['RB-A-S','RB-B-S'],['END-B','RB-B-N'],['RB-A-S','END-Q'],['RB-A-N','RB-A-S'],['RB-B-S','RB-B-N'],['RB-A-N','DOOR-1'],['RB-A-N','DOOR-2'],['RB-A-N','DOOR-3'],['DOOR-3','RB-SP-S'],['DOOR-2','RB-A-S'],['RB-SP-S','DOOR-1'],['RB-SP-S','DOOR-3']];
 for(const [a,b] of need)if(!railRoute(a,b))issues.push('no-route:'+a+'>'+b);
 if(railRoute('RB-A-S','RB-A-N')&&!RAIL_SEG_BY_ID.XN)issues.push('main-A-reverse-route-exists');
 if(RailOps.enabled&&!RailOps.freightLive)issues.push('rail-ops-enabled-without-freight-service');
 // port links point at real things
 const poi=navPoiRegistry();
 for(const l of PORT_LINKS){if(l.mode==='road'&&!byNode[l.node])issues.push(l.id+':no-road-node');if(l.mode==='rail'&&!RAIL_CONNECTORS.some(c=>c.id===l.connector))issues.push(l.id+':no-connector');if(l.mode==='power'&&!E5_PYLONS.length)issues.push(l.id+':no-pylon')}
 for(const f of PORT_FLOWS)for(const st of f.steps)if(!poi[st]&&!RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[st])issues.push(f.id+':missing:'+st);
 // the road connectors of E5 match the graph
 for(const id of['E5-SB'])if(!byNode[id])issues.push('road-connector-missing:'+id);   /* S9 · S7F268: E5-NW and E5-W are out with the old roads (the map) */
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,14),issueCount:issues.length,...railNetStats(),portLinks:PORT_LINKS.length,portFlows:PORT_FLOWS.length}}

// ---- Drawing -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function e5InView(pad=60){return e3InView(E5_BOX.x,E5_BOX.y,E5_BOX.w,E5_BOX.h,pad)}
function e5Specks(c){return e4Specks(c)}
// ---- Yard track rendering (v1.75): layered passes + welded turnout seams --------------------------------
// 1 ground shoulder (soft gravel that follows the tracks) 2 ballast beds 3 ties (perpendicular to the local direction) 4 rails.
// Beds are 40 px wide, 48 px apart, so a narrow gap of ground stays visible between tracks. Curves are sampled polylines.
function e5Walk(pts,step,off=0){const out=[];let next=off;for(let k=1;k<pts.length;k++){const x1=pts[k-1][0],y1=pts[k-1][1],x2=pts[k][0],y2=pts[k][1],L=Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1);if(!L)continue;const ux=(x2-x1)/L,uy=(y2-y1)/L;let d=next;while(d<L){out.push({x:x1+ux*d,y:y1+uy*d,nx:-uy,ny:ux});d+=step}next=d-L}return out}
function e5OffsetPts(pts,o){return pts.map((p,i)=>{const a=pts[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=pts[Math.min(pts.length-1,i+1)],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;return[p[0]-dy/L*o,p[1]+dx/L*o]})}
// v1.75: weld rail endpoints to the exact rail position of any vertical parent track at a shared node.
// The centre-lines already met, but separately offset rails could end ~0.5-0.8 px above/below each other on a turnout.
function e5RailOffsetPts(seg,o){const out=e5OffsetPts(seg.pts,o),snap=(idx,nodeId)=>{const n=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[nodeId];if(!n)return;const hasVerticalMate=RAIL_SEGS.some(q=>q.id!==seg.id&&(q.from===nodeId||q.to===nodeId)&&q.pts.length===2&&Math.abs(q.pts[0][0]-q.pts[1][0])<.01);if(!hasVerticalMate)return;const side=Math.sign(out[idx][0]-n.x)||Math.sign(-o)||1;out[idx]=[n.x+side*Math.abs(o),n.y]};snap(0,seg.from);snap(out.length-1,seg.to);return out}
function e5PathOf(pts){ctx.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]))}
let E5_YARD_SPECKS=null;
function e5YardSpecks(){if(E5_YARD_SPECKS)return E5_YARD_SPECKS;let s=90210;const r=()=>{s=(s*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296},out=[];for(const g of RAIL_SEGS)if(g.yard)for(const q of e5Walk(g.pts,9,r()*9))for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const o=(r()*2-1)*32;out.push([q.x+q.nx*o,q.y+q.ny*o,r()<.5?1:0,.7+r()*1.3])}return E5_YARD_SPECKS=out}
function e5YardShoulder(zoomOk){
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(E5_BOX.x,E5_BOX.y,E5_BOX.w,E5_BOX.h);ctx.clip();ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';
 const segs=RAIL_SEGS.filter(s=>s.yard);
 for(const [w,col] of[[84,'rgba(124,119,108,.10)'],[72,'rgba(124,119,108,.24)'],[60,'#7a766d']]){ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.beginPath();for(const s of segs)s.pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));ctx.stroke()}
 if(zoomOk)for(const [sx,sy,l,z] of e5YardSpecks()){ctx.fillStyle=l?'rgba(214,208,190,.30)':'rgba(30,30,28,.30)';ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,z,z)}
 ctx.restore()}
function e5DrawYardTracks(pass){
 const segs=RAIL_SEGS.filter(s=>s.yard),all=!pass;
 ctx.save();ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';
 if(all||pass==='bed'){for(const [w,col] of[[44,'#767b7d'],[40,'#666b6d']]){ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=w;for(const s of segs){e5PathOf(s.pts);ctx.stroke()}}}
 if(all||pass==='ties'){ctx.lineCap='butt';ctx.strokeStyle='#413d37';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();for(const s of segs)for(const q of e5Walk(s.pts,15,7)){ctx.moveTo(q.x-q.nx*18,q.y-q.ny*18);ctx.lineTo(q.x+q.nx*18,q.y+q.ny*18)}ctx.stroke()}
 // v1.77: same gauge (26 px) as the main tracks, so every turnout rail meets the main rail exactly
 if(all||pass==='rails'){ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.strokeStyle='#c6cbd0';ctx.lineWidth=3;for(const o of[-13,13])for(const s of segs){e5PathOf(e5RailOffsetPts(s,o));ctx.stroke()}}
 ctx.restore()}

/* S9 · S7F268: e5IntegrationAudit ו-drawE5Ground הישנות יצאו — החדשות ב-019b */
/* ==== S13 — המשך · D‑634א (הבעלים 15:07: "מסילות כפולות לאורך כל הדרך — גם לאי וגם לקצה המזרחי"): מסילת המזרח הכפולה ====
   הפס הצפוני EAST-N1: מהמסוט EAST-JN ב-(6460, 5120) על הפס הקיים, בקו של מסילת ההיפוך של המפה (SIDING של F6 — 019d) עד (6765, 5050), ומשם ישר מזרחה עד קצה העולם
   (14400, 5050) — 7 מ׳ מהפס הקיים (y 5120). המסוט מחלק את EAST-B3 (→ EAST-B3 עד EAST-JN, ו-EAST-B4 עד ISL-J). שני הפסים ברשת של הסימולציה; בקצה המזרחי — שתי יציאות.
   למיזוג עם s10b (D‑596, הגשר של מסילת המזרח מעל יציאת המרינה, x 6585–6965): המפתח צריך לשאת גם את EAST-N1 (העמודים שלו — בלי עמוד בנתיב, כמו SIDING-F6),
   והסינון של העמודים ב-rlPiers — ל-EAST-B4 ול-EAST-N1 (אצלם: EAST-B ו-SIDING-F6). ==== */
(function(){try{const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['EAST-B3'];if(!g||g.to!=='ISL-J')throw new Error('EAST-B3');

// ===== QUAY OPERATIONS (v1.89) ==========================================================================================================
// Ships are drawn in full proportion (a container ship carries 8 containers across), the gantry cranes ride their rails, and every berth runs
// the same cycle: a ship arrives, is worked until it is full, leaves, and a new ship arrives. Everything is a pure function of the clock, so
// there is nothing to save and nothing can desynchronise. Scale: 12 px per metre; a container is FREIGHT_W (29 px) wide.
// GATE-75 · PORT-08: the portal is 184 px between leg centres (inner clearance 168 px between the legs, 178 px between the side frames) so the
// longest load — a pair of 20 ft boxes, 150 px, 159 px hoisted — passes between the legs; two cranes keep FL_CRANE_SEP (bogie to bogie + 6 px)
const PORT_PITCH=158,PORT_ROWP=PORT_CT_W+2,PORT_STERN=170,PORT_BOWL=230,PORT_TM=5.2,PORT_LANE_Y=5068,PORT_HW=92,PORT_YDOCK=PORT_QY+6;
const PORT_ARRIVE=16,PORT_DEPART=16,PORT_GAP=10,PORT_SLIDE=420;
const PORT_BERTHS=[
 /* S10 א: הרציף C6 יצא ממחזור האוניות (אונייה שמופיעה ונעלמת — כלל 25); אוניית המכולות של C6 עוגנת במקום, והמנופים שלה ב-021d */
 {id:'E6',chunk:'E6',kind:'container',cx:5270,bays:4,rows:8,dir:1,t0:61,cranes:[['E6-CR1',[0,1]],['E6-CR2',[2,3]]],wagonCranes:['E6-CR1','E6-CR2'],label:'רציף מים עמוקים E6 · עגינה ב-E7'}
 /* S10 א: D6-BULK יצא — ב-D6 עוגנת אוניית הרכבים (021d) */
];
for(const b of PORT_BERTHS){
 if(b.kind==='container'){b.L=PORT_STERN+b.bays*PORT_PITCH+PORT_BOWL;b.B=Math.round(b.rows*PORT_ROWP+26)}
 b.yc=PORT_YDOCK+b.B/2;b.x0=b.cx-b.L/2;b.x1=b.cx+b.L/2;
 b.cargoX0=b.x0+(b.dir>0?PORT_STERN:PORT_BOWL);      // world x of the westmost cargo bay
 b.cargoY0=b.yc-(b.rows||0)*PORT_ROWP/2;              // world y of the northmost row
 // world x of working station i: a cargo bay (container ships) or a hatch (bulk carrier)
 b.stationX=i=>b.kind==='bulk'?b.cx+(i-(b.hatches-1)/2)*120:b.cargoX0+i*PORT_PITCH+PORT_PITCH/2;
 b.load=b.kind==='container'?3+Math.max(...b.cranes.map(([,s])=>s.length*b.rows))*PORT_TM+4:b.dwell;
 b.cycle=PORT_ARRIVE+b.load+PORT_DEPART+PORT_GAP;
}
const portBerth=id=>PORT_BERTHS.find(b=>b.id===id);
// Gantry cranes: four leg posts (collision bodies that follow the crane), two rails, a boom reaching over the whole ship.
const PORT_CRANES=[];
for(const b of PORT_BERTHS)for(const [id,set] of (b.cranes||[])){
 const home=b.stationX(set[0]),c={id,berth:b.id,chunk:b.chunk,set,home,cx:home,kind:b.kind==='bulk'?'grab':'spreader',legs:[]};
 for(const [dx,y,k] of[[-1,PORT_RAIL_W,'WL'],[1,PORT_RAIL_W,'WR'],[-1,PORT_RAIL_L,'LL'],[1,PORT_RAIL_L,'LR']])c.legs.push({dx,y,solid:portSolid(id+'-LEG-'+k,home+dx*PORT_HW-8,y-8,16,16)});
 PORT_CRANES.push(c);
}
for(const c of PORT_CRANES)if(c.kind==='grab')c.pile=PORT_PILES.find(q=>Math.abs(q.cx-c.home)<2)||null;
const portCraneById=id=>PORT_CRANES.find(c=>c.id===id);

// ---- tiny deterministic helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function portHash(str){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){h^=str.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0}
function portRng(seed){let s=(seed>>>0)||1;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296}}
const portEase=x=>x<=0?0:x>=1?1:x<.5?2*x*x:1-Math.pow(-2*x+2,2)/2;
const portLerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const PORT_LIVERIES={
 container:[
  {id:'navy',hull:'#1b3a63',stripe:'#c43b2f',deck:'#7d878c',funnel:'#c43b2f'},
  {id:'maroon',hull:'#6e1e26',stripe:'#e0b93a',deck:'#7d878c',funnel:'#e0b93a'},
  {id:'green',hull:'#1d5a44',stripe:'#f1f1ec',deck:'#7a8a86',funnel:'#f1f1ec'},
  {id:'steel',hull:'#2d3338',stripe:'#2e86c1',deck:'#80898d',funnel:'#2e86c1'},
  {id:'teal',hull:'#0f4d68',stripe:'#e08a1e',deck:'#7d878c',funnel:'#e08a1e'},
  {id:'sand',hull:'#8a6a2f',stripe:'#1d3a63',deck:'#8a8e8a',funnel:'#1d3a63'}],
 bulk:[
  {id:'b-red',hull:'#7a2b22',stripe:'#e8e4da',deck:'#3f6a4c',funnel:'#e8e4da',hatch:'#9a4a36'},
  {id:'b-blue',hull:'#24456e',stripe:'#e0b93a',deck:'#7a6a4a',funnel:'#e0b93a',hatch:'#3f6a8a'},
  {id:'b-green',hull:'#2a5a3c',stripe:'#e8e4da',deck:'#8a7a52',funnel:'#c43b2f',hatch:'#4a7a5a'}],
 ferry:[
  {id:'f-white',hull:'#f2f4f5',stripe:'#1f6fb0',deck:'#cfd6d9',funnel:'#e0b93a',cabin:'#fafbfb'},
  {id:'f-blue',hull:'#e8edf0',stripe:'#c43b2f',deck:'#c9d2d6',funnel:'#1f6fb0',cabin:'#f6f8f9'}]
};
const PORT_NAMES={container:['נשר הים','כוכב הדרום','אפיק','שחר הים','מגדל הים','גל־עד'],bulk:['צוק הים','חוף הכרמל','עוז','אלמוג'],ferry:['שירת הים','נחשון']};
const portLivery=(b,k)=>{const a=PORT_LIVERIES[b.kind];return a[(portHash(b.id)+k)%a.length]};
// the two container berths use the even / odd names, so no two ships alongside ever carry the same name
const portShipName=(b,k)=>{const L=PORT_NAMES[b.kind];return b.kind==='container'?L[(k*2+(b.id==='E6'?1:0))%L.length]:L[(k+portHash(b.id))%L.length]};

// ---- the cargo of one ship call: every slot is a 12 m box or a pair of 6 m boxes; cranes work their own bays, far rows first -----------------
const __slotCache=new Map();
function portSlots(b,k){
 const key=b.id+'|'+k;let o=__slotCache.get(key);if(o)return o;
 const rnd=portRng(portHash(key)),cranes=[];let id=0;
 for(const [cid,set] of b.cranes){
  const list=[];
  for(const wb of set)for(let wr=b.rows-1;wr>=0;wr--){
   const t20=rnd()<.32,r1=rnd(),r2=rnd();
   list.push({id:id++,wb,wr,type:t20?'20':'40',asset:t20?'CT-20-01':r1<.14?'CT-RF-01':r1<.28?'CT-OP-01':'CT-40-01',v:Math.floor(rnd()*8),v2:Math.floor(rnd()*8),cx:b.cargoX0+wb*PORT_PITCH+PORT_PITCH/2,cy:b.cargoY0+wr*PORT_ROWP+PORT_ROWP/2,truck:Math.floor(rnd()*8)});
  }
  cranes.push({id:cid,list});
 }
 o={cranes,total:id};if(__slotCache.size>20)__slotCache.delete(__slotCache.keys().next().value);__slotCache.set(key,o);return o;
}
// ---- berth clock ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function portBerthAtOld(b,now){
 const T=now/1000+b.t0,k=Math.floor(T/b.cycle),tin=T-k*b.cycle;
 let phase,u=1,loadT=0;
 if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE){phase='arrive';u=tin/PORT_ARRIVE}
 else if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE+b.load){phase='load';loadT=tin-PORT_ARRIVE}
 else if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE+b.load+PORT_DEPART){phase='depart';u=(tin-PORT_ARRIVE-b.load)/PORT_DEPART;loadT=b.load}
 else{phase='gap';loadT=b.load}
 let off=0,alpha=1;
 if(phase==='arrive'){off=PORT_SLIDE*(1-portEase(u));alpha=Math.min(1,u*3.2)}
 else if(phase==='depart'){off=PORT_SLIDE*portEase(u);alpha=Math.min(1,(1-u)*3.2)}
 else if(phase==='gap'){off=PORT_SLIDE;alpha=0}
 // boom: raised (short) when no ship is alongside, lowered over the ship while one is being worked
 let ext=0;
 if(phase==='arrive')ext=portEase((tin-(PORT_ARRIVE-7))/6);
 else if(phase==='load')ext=1;
 else if(phase==='depart')ext=1-portEase((tin-PORT_ARRIVE-b.load)/6);
 return{b,k,tin,phase,u,loadT,off,alpha,ext,present:phase!=='gap',name:portShipName(b,k),livery:portLivery(b,k)};
}
let __opsT=-1,__ops=null;
function portOps(now){
 if(__opsT===now&&__ops)return __ops;
 const m={};for(const b of PORT_BERTHS)m[b.id]=portBerthAt(b,now);
 __opsT=now;__ops=m;return m;
}
// moves of one crane: move j starts at loadT = 3 + j·TM; phases of a move: p 0-.10 spreader on the box · .10-.24 hoist · .24-.56 trolley out ·
// .56-.70 lower (box is now part of the ship) · .70-.76 release · .76-1 spreader up, trolley back and gantry to the next bay
function portCranePoseOld(c,S,now){
 const b=S.b,tipFar=(b.kind==='bulk'?b.yc+b.B/2:b.cargoY0+b.rows*PORT_ROWP)+4,tipNear=PORT_RAIL_W+78;
 const P={x:c.home,tipY:portLerp(tipNear,tipFar,S.ext),ty:PORT_LANE_Y,h:0,load:null,slot:null,grab:null,j:-1,p:0};
 if(b.kind==='bulk'){
  const hx=b.stationX(c.set[0]),py=c.pile?c.pile.cy:PORT_RAIL_L+34,hy=b.yc;
  if(S.phase==='load'||(S.phase==='arrive'&&S.tin>PORT_ARRIVE-3)){
   const tt=Math.max(0,S.loadT)+(c.id==='D6-CR2'?3.4:0),Tg=8,p=((tt%Tg)+Tg)%Tg/Tg;P.p=p;
   P.x=hx;
   // hatch → pile: lower into the hold, close, hoist, trolley to the pile, open, raise, back
   if(p<.15){P.ty=hy;P.h=1-p/.15*.0;P.grab={open:1,fill:0};P.hh=portEase(p/.15)}
   else if(p<.30){P.ty=hy;P.grab={open:1-portEase((p-.15)/.15),fill:1};P.hh=1-portEase((p-.15)/.15)*.0}
   else if(p<.55){P.ty=portLerp(hy,py,portEase((p-.30)/.25));P.grab={open:0,fill:1};P.hh=1}
   else if(p<.68){P.ty=py;P.grab={open:portEase((p-.55)/.13),fill:1-portEase((p-.55)/.13)};P.hh=1-portEase((p-.55)/.13)*.55}
   else if(p<.80){P.ty=py;P.grab={open:1,fill:0};P.hh=.45+portEase((p-.68)/.12)*.55}
   else{P.ty=portLerp(py,hy,portEase((p-.80)/.20));P.grab={open:1,fill:0};P.hh=1}
   P.h=P.hh;
  }else{P.ty=PORT_RAIL_W+60}
  return P;
 }
 // container ship
 const list=portSlots(b,S.k).cranes.find(q=>q.id===c.id).list,n=list.length;
 if(S.phase==='arrive'||S.phase==='gap'){P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;return P}
 const first=list[0],last=list[n-1];
 if(S.phase==='depart'){const e=portEase(S.u/.6);P.x=portLerp(last.cx,c.home,e);P.ty=portLerp(PORT_LANE_Y,PORT_RAIL_W+60,portEase(S.u/.3));return P}
 const q=(S.loadT-3)/PORT_TM;
 if(q<0){P.x=portLerp(c.home,first.cx,portEase((S.loadT)/3));return P}
 const j=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(q));
 if(q>=n){P.x=last.cx;P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;P.j=n;return P}
 const p=q-j,s=list[j],nx=list[j+1];
 P.j=j;P.p=p;P.slot=s;
 let xs=s.cx;
 if(p>.76){const to=nx?nx.cx:s.cx;xs=portLerp(s.cx,to,portEase((p-.76)/.24))}
 P.x=xs;
 // trolley (y) and hoist height (h: 0 on the ground / ship, 1 raised)
 if(p<.10){P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;P.h=.6*(1-portEase(p/.10))}
 else if(p<.24){P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;P.h=portEase((p-.10)/.14)}
 else if(p<.56){P.ty=portLerp(PORT_LANE_Y,s.cy,portEase((p-.24)/.32));P.h=1}
 else if(p<.70){P.ty=s.cy;P.h=1-portEase((p-.56)/.14)}
 else if(p<.76){P.ty=s.cy;P.h=0}
 else{P.ty=portLerp(s.cy,PORT_LANE_Y,portEase((p-.76)/.24));P.h=.6*portEase((p-.76)/.12)}
 if(p>=.10&&p<.70)P.load=s;   // box hanging on the spreader
 return P;
}
// containers already on the ship (per crane list: the first `done` slots)
function portDoneCount(c,S,n){
 if(S.phase==='arrive'||S.phase==='gap')return 0;
 if(S.phase==='depart')return n;
 const q=(S.loadT-3)/PORT_TM-.70;return Math.max(0,Math.min(n,Math.floor(q)+1));
}
// container trucks queueing for one crane: move j's truck arrives during q ∈ [-.55,0], waits until the lift (q .10) and drives off by q .55
function portTrucks(c,S){
 const out=[];if(c.kind!=='spreader'||S.phase!=='load')return out;
 const list=portSlots(S.b,S.k).cranes.find(q=>q.id===c.id).list,n=list.length,q=(S.loadT-3)/PORT_TM;
 for(let j=Math.max(0,Math.floor(q)-1);j<=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(q)+1);j++){
  const qq=q-j,s=list[j];if(qq<-.55||qq>.55)continue;
  let x=s.cx,al=1;
  if(qq<0){const e=portEase((qq+.55)/.55);x=s.cx-230*(1-e);al=Math.min(1,(qq+.55)/.07)}
  else if(qq>.12){const e=portEase((qq-.12)/.43);x=s.cx+230*e;al=Math.min(1,(.55-qq)/.08)}
  out.push({x,y:PORT_LANE_Y,alpha:al,slot:s,carry:qq<.10});
 }
 return out;
}

// ---- sprites (cached, one per ship call) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const PORT_SPRITES=new Map();
function portSprite(key,w,h,paint,q=1){
 let o=PORT_SPRITES.get(key);
 if(!o){const c=window.document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.ceil(w*q);c.height=Math.ceil(h*q);const g=c.getContext('2d');g.scale(q,q);g.translate(w/2,h/2);
  try{paint(g);o={cv:c,w,h}}catch(e){o={cv:null,err:String(e&&e.message||e)}}PORT_SPRITES.set(key,o)}
 return o;
}
function portDropSprites(prefix,keep){for(const k of [...PORT_SPRITES.keys()])if(k.startsWith(prefix)&&k!==keep){const o=PORT_SPRITES.get(k);PORT_SPRITES.delete(k);if(o&&o.cv)try{o.cv.width=0;o.cv.height=0}catch(e){}}}   /* K-163 · p270 */
// hull outline, bow towards +x; `inset` shrinks it (negative grows it)
function portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,inset=0){
 const hl=L/2-inset,hb=B/2-inset,bl=Math.max(20,bowLen-inset*.6),sr=Math.max(5,26-inset);
 g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-hl+sr,-hb);g.lineTo(hl-bl,-hb);
 g.bezierCurveTo(hl-bl*.38,-hb,hl-bl*.12,-hb*.62,hl,0);
 g.bezierCurveTo(hl-bl*.12,hb*.62,hl-bl*.38,hb,hl-bl,hb);
 g.lineTo(-hl+sr,hb);g.quadraticCurveTo(-hl,hb,-hl,hb-sr);g.lineTo(-hl,-hb+sr);g.quadraticCurveTo(-hl,-hb,-hl+sr,-hb);g.closePath();
}
function portShadowRect(g,x,y,w,h,dx=5,dy=6){g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.26)';g.fillRect(x+dx,y+dy,w,h)}
function portHullBase(g,L,B,bowLen,lv,deckCol){
 g.save();portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,-4);g.fillStyle='rgba(235,247,252,.32)';g.fill();g.restore();   // foam halo at the waterline
 portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,0);g.fillStyle=lv.hull;g.fill();
 const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,-B/2,0,B/2);gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.18)');gr.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.30)');g.fillStyle=gr;portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,0);g.fill();
 portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,4.5);g.lineWidth=4;g.strokeStyle=lv.stripe;g.stroke();
 portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,9);g.fillStyle=deckCol||lv.deck;g.fill();g.lineWidth=1.2;g.strokeStyle='rgba(20,28,34,.6)';g.stroke();
}
function portBollards(g,L,B,bowLen,from,to,step=70){
 const hb=B/2-12;g.fillStyle='#2e3438';
 for(let x=from;x<=to;x+=step){for(const y of[-hb,hb]){g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,3.2,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}}
}
function paintContainerShip(g,b,lv){
 const L=b.L,B=b.B,hl=L/2,hb=B/2,cx0=-hl+PORT_STERN,cw=b.bays*PORT_PITCH;
 portHullBase(g,L,B,PORT_BOWL,lv);
 // cargo bays: hatch floor with cell guides (the boxes themselves are drawn per slot as the cranes place them)
 g.fillStyle='#566268';g.fillRect(cx0-2,-hb+12,cw+4,B-24);
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.14)';g.lineWidth=1;g.beginPath();
 for(let i=0;i<=b.bays;i++){g.moveTo(cx0+i*PORT_PITCH,-hb+12);g.lineTo(cx0+i*PORT_PITCH,hb-12)}
 for(let r=0;r<=b.rows;r++){const y=-b.rows*PORT_ROWP/2+r*PORT_ROWP;g.moveTo(cx0,y);g.lineTo(cx0+cw,y)}

const PORT_PAINT={container:paintContainerShip,bulk:paintBulkShip,ferry:paintFerry};
function portCargoLayer(b,k){
 const key='cargo|'+b.id+'|'+k,w=b.bays*PORT_PITCH,h=b.rows*PORT_ROWP,q=1.5;
 let o=PORT_SPRITES.get(key);
 if(!o){
  const c=window.document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.ceil(w*q);c.height=Math.ceil(h*q);const g=c.getContext('2d');g.scale(q,q);
  try{
   for(const cr of portSlots(b,k).cranes)for(const s of cr.list){
    const lx=s.cx-b.cargoX0,ly=s.cy-b.cargoY0;
    const one=(asset,dx,v)=>{const I=TurboCity.info(asset,{scale:PORT_CT_SCALE});TurboCity.draw(g,asset,lx+dx-I.w/2,ly-I.h/2,{mode:'runtime',scale:PORT_CT_SCALE,variant:v,time:0})};
    if(s.type==='40')one(s.asset,0,s.v);else{one('CT-20-01',-(PORT_CT_LEN['CT-20-01']/2+2),s.v);one('CT-20-01',(PORT_CT_LEN['CT-20-01']/2+2),s.v2)}
   }
   o={cv:c,w,h}}catch(e){o={cv:null,err:String(e&&e.message||e)}}
  PORT_SPRITES.set(key,o);
 }
 return o;
}
// harbour craft: bow towards the quay (north); sizes from real hulls at 12 px/m — tug 25 × 9.5 m, pilot boat 12 × 3.8 m
const PORT_BOATS=[
 {id:'E6-TUG',label:'גוררת נמל',paint:paintTug,L:270,B:100,x:5898,y:PORT_QY+10},
 {id:'E6-PILOT',label:'סירת נחה',paint:paintPilot,L:120,B:40,x:5974,y:PORT_QY+10}
];
function drawPortShips(v,now){if(WTC_LP===1)return;
 const ops=portOps(now);
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(PORT_BOX.x,PORT_QY-40,PORT_BOX.w,900);ctx.clip();
 for(const b of PORT_BERTHS){
  const S=ops[b.id];if(!S.present)continue;
  const x=b.cx,y=b.yc+S.off;
  if(!portVis(v,b.x0-30,y-b.B/2-34,b.L+60,b.B+80))continue;
  const bob=Math.sin(now/1700+b.cx*.01)*.7*(S.phase==='load'?.6:1),pad=30,w=b.L+pad*2,h=b.B+pad*2,key='ship|'+b.id+'|'+S.k;
  portDropSprites('ship|'+b.id+'|',key);portDropSprites('cargo|'+b.id+'|','cargo|'+b.id+'|'+S.k);
  const sp=portSprite(key,w,h,g=>{if(b.dir<0)g.rotate(Math.PI);PORT_PAINT[b.kind](g,b,S.livery)},1);
  ctx.globalAlpha=S.alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,20,34,.30)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+4,y+bob+9,b.L/2-8,b.B/2+1,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  if(sp.cv)ctx.drawImage(sp.cv,x-w/2,y-h/2+bob,w,h);
  // cargo: the boxes that stand on deck right now (planned call: imports leave from the top, exports arrive from the bottom)
  if(b.kind==='container')flDrawCargo(b,S,bob);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  Targets.add({id:'SHIP-'+b.id,label:(b.kind==='container'?'אוניית מכולות · ':b.kind==='bulk'?'מובילת תפזורת · ':'מעבורת · ')+S.name,category:'port-ship',x:b.cx,y:y,w:b.L,h:b.B});
 }
 // standing boats: the harbour tug and the pilot boat lie bow-in at the east end of the quay
 for(const o of PORT_BOATS){
  if(o.away&&o.away(now))continue;   /* S9 · S7F270: the pilot boat is out on the patrol of the buoys of the lane (038c) — drawn there */
  if(!portVis(v,o.x-o.B/2-10,o.y-6,o.B+20,o.L+20))continue;
  const key='boat|'+o.id,w=o.B+40,h=o.L+40,sp=portSprite(key,w,h,g=>{g.rotate(-Math.PI/2);o.paint(g,o.L,o.B)},1.5);
  const bob=Math.sin(now/1500+o.x*.02)*.6;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,20,34,.30)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(o.x+3,o.y+o.L/2+8+bob,o.B/2,o.L/2-4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  if(sp.cv)ctx.drawImage(sp.cv,o.x-w/2,o.y+o.L/2-h/2+bob,w,h);
  Targets.add({id:o.id,label:o.label,category:'port-ship',x:o.x,y:o.y+o.L/2,w:o.B,h:o.L});
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

// box centre on the trailer, relative to the truck centre: the trailer part of the semi starts at the rear end of the sprite
const PORT_TRUCK_BOX_DX=(()=>{const sc=roadVehicleScaleFor('LV-SM-01','SemiLong'),S=TurboCity.info('LV-SM-01',{scale:sc}),T=TurboCity.info('LV-TL-01',{scale:sc});return -(S.fp[2]-T.fp[2])/2-2})();
// ---- drawing: gantry cranes (overhead layer) — GATE-75 · PORT-08: drawn in physical height order -----------------------------------------
// 'portal' : ground shadows, rail bogies, the legs and the portal beams at both rails, the side frames between them
// 'load'   : what hangs under the trolley — the box (with its height shadow) and the spreader holding it, or the grab
// 'top'    : boom girder (lattice, tip block, back-reach end), machinery house and the trolley that runs on the boom
// A box is therefore always UNDER the spreader / trolley / boom / machinery house and never painted over the crane. Between the rails it stays
// between the side frames (inner clearance 2·(PORT_HW−3) = 178 px against a hoisted 20+20 ft pair of 159 px) and it crosses a portal beam only
// hoisted (h ≥ .85) — see portCraneTraceAudit. g / only: target context and layer filter (the render probe of the audit draws single layers).
const PORT_CRANE_LAYERS=['portal','load','top'],PORT_BOX_HEIGHT_K=.06;
function drawPortCrane(c,P,S,now,g=ctx,only=null){__tcDrawn('drawPortCrane');

   g.fillStyle='#3c7ac2';g.fillRect(x-hw-7,y-7,14,14);g.fillRect(x+hw-7,y-7,14,14);g.strokeStyle='rgba(10,24,40,.7)';g.lineWidth=1;g.strokeRect(x-hw-6.5,y-6.5,13,13);g.strokeRect(x+hw-6.5,y-6.5,13,13)}
  g.fillStyle='#2f6aa6';g.fillRect(x-hw-3,yL,6,yW-yL);g.fillRect(x+hw-3,yL,6,yW-yL);
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(10,24,40,.55)';g.lineWidth=1;g.beginPath();for(let y=yL+8;y<yW-10;y+=20){g.moveTo(x-hw-3,y);g.lineTo(x-hw+3,y+20);g.moveTo(x+hw+3,y);g.lineTo(x+hw-3,y+20)}g.stroke();

    if(s.type==='40')one(s.asset,0,s.v);else{one('CT-20-01',-(PORT_CT_LEN['CT-20-01']/2+2),s.v);one('CT-20-01',(PORT_CT_LEN['CT-20-01']/2+2),s.v2)}
    g.restore()}
   // spreader frame (twist-locks at the four corners): it sits on the box it holds
   g.save();g.translate(x,ty);g.scale(k,k);g.strokeStyle='#2a2f33';g.lineWidth=2;g.strokeRect(-L/2,-PORT_CT_W/2,L,PORT_CT_W);g.fillStyle='#e0b93a';for(const sx of[-1,1])for(const sy of[-1,1])g.fillRect(sx*(L/2-4)-3,sy*(PORT_CT_W/2-4)-3,6,6);g.restore();

 }

  if(c.kind==='spreader'){g.fillRect(x-14,boomTop-3,28,6);g.fillStyle='#3b3f44';g.fillRect(x-14,boomTop-3,28,4)}
  g.fillStyle='#d9dde0';g.fillRect(x-24,yL-42,48,38);g.strokeStyle='rgba(40,50,56,.7)';g.lineWidth=1;g.strokeRect(x-23.5,yL-41.5,47,37);g.fillStyle='#e0731d';g.fillRect(x-24,yL-42,48,5);

const PORT_SEG_GROUPS=(()=>{const by=id=>RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id];return{
 curves:['XOVER','SP-1','A-ARC','A-ARC2','P2-LINK'].map(by),
 mains:['A-4','A-5','B-2','B-3'].map(by),
 // GATE-75 S2: every flush straight of the four port tracks (and the east-line stretch to the coast) and the three flush S-links
 siding:['Q-SID-E','Q-SID-D','Q-SID-XQ','Q-SID-X','Q-SID-C','Q-BASE','Q-BASE-E','Q2-C','Q2-D1','Q2-D2','Q2-E','P1','P2'].map(by),
 flushCurves:['X-P1','X-Q2','Q2-LINK'].map(by)}})();
const PORT_FLUSH_LIST=[...PORT_SEG_GROUPS.siding,...PORT_SEG_GROUPS.flushCurves],PORT_FLUSH_SEGS=new Set(PORT_FLUSH_LIST.map(s=>s.id));
const PORT_TRK_Y0=PORT_P_Y-40,PORT_TRK_H=PORT_W2_Y-PORT_P_Y+80;
// switch stands beside the four new turnouts (each ≥ 18 px clear of every track centre line)
const PORT_SWITCH_STANDS=[[3815,5099],[3895,5099],[4090,5139],[5835,5099],[5400+428*Math.cos(PORT_ASW_A),4720+428*Math.sin(PORT_ASW_A)]];
// trench edge lines of the flush tracks: only on the outer side of a bed (between two neighbouring tracks the beds touch) and not where an
// S-link crosses the edge
let PORT_TRENCH_EDGES=null;
function portTrenchEdges(){if(PORT_TRENCH_EDGES)return PORT_TRENCH_EDGES;const out=[],st=PORT_FLUSH_LIST.filter(s=>s.pts.length===2&&s.pts[0][1]===s.pts[1][1]),cv=PORT_FLUSH_LIST.filter(s=>s.pts.length>2);
 for(const s of st){const y=s.pts[0][1],x0=Math.min(s.pts[0][0],s.pts[1][0]),x1=Math.max(s.pts[0][0],s.pts[1][0]);
  for(const sg of[-1,1]){const ey=y+sg*20.25,cut=[];
   for(const o of st){if(o===s)continue;const d=sg*(o.pts[0][1]-y);if(d>0&&d<=44)cut.push([Math.min(o.pts[0][0],o.pts[1][0]),Math.max(o.pts[0][0],o.pts[1][0])])}
   for(const c of cv){let lo=1e9,hi=-1e9,ylo=1e9,yhi=-1e9;for(const p of c.pts){lo=Math.min(lo,p[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,p[0]);ylo=Math.min(ylo,p[1]);yhi=Math.max(yhi,p[1])}if(ey>=ylo-22&&ey<=yhi+22)cut.push([lo,hi])}
   let segs=[[x0,x1]];for(const [a,b] of cut){const nx=[];for(const [p,q] of segs){if(b<=p||a>=q){nx.push([p,q]);continue}if(a>p)nx.push([p,a]);if(b<q)nx.push([b,q])}segs=nx}
   for(const [p,q] of segs)if(q-p>1)out.push([p,ey-.75,q-p,1.5])}}
 return PORT_TRENCH_EDGES=out}

 if(pass==='ties'){ctx.lineCap='butt';ctx.strokeStyle='#413d37';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();for(const s of segs)for(const q of e5Walk(s.pts,15,7)){ctx.moveTo(q.x-q.nx*18,q.y-q.ny*18);ctx.lineTo(q.x+q.nx*18,q.y+q.ny*18)}ctx.stroke()}

function portPaintSiding(g,b){
 // GATE-75 S2: every flush port track (W1, W2, P1, P2, the crossovers X-P1 / X-Q2 and the W2 link) on its own line: groove, tie plates, rails
 const G=PORT_SEG_GROUPS,inB=s=>{let lo=1e9,hi=-1e9;for(const p of s.pts){lo=Math.min(lo,p[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,p[0])}return hi>=b.x-40&&lo<=b.x+b.w+40};
 const st=G.siding.filter(inB),cv=G.flushCurves.filter(inB),all=[...st,...cv];
 g.save();g.lineCap='butt';g.lineJoin='round';
 // grooves (one stroke: where two beds touch the groove is not darkened twice)
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(40,38,34,.45)';g.lineWidth=32;g.beginPath();for(const s of all)s.pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?g.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):g.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));g.stroke();

// ---- Collision: tracks, obstacles, the water --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const PORT_WATER={x:2400,y:PORT_QY-2,w:3600,h:240};
function portRailCollision(x,y,r=12){if(x<5440||x>6020||y<4230||y>5220)return null;for(const z of PORT_RAIL_ZONES)if(circleRectHit(x,y,r,z))return z.id;return null}
function portSolidAt(x,y,r=12){
 if(x<2380||x>6020||y<4230||y>5450)return null;
 if(circleRectHit(x,y,r,PORT_WATER))return 'PORT-WATER';
 for(const s of PORT_SOLIDS){if((s.r?Math.hypot(x-s.cx,y-s.cy)<s.r+r:circleRectHit(x,y,r,s))&&(!s.when||s.when()))return s.id}
 return rlCarHit(x,y,r)}

// ---- Roads of the port as rectangles (for placement and audits) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function portRoadRects(){return EDGES.filter(e=>/^TC-(E6|D6|C6)-/.test(e.globalRoadId)).map(e=>{const a=_NODE_BY_ID[e.a],b=_NODE_BY_ID[e.b],h=_ROAD_HALF(e);return{id:e.id,gid:e.globalRoadId,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+h*2,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+h*2}})}
const portOver=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y;
const portInside=(a,b)=>a.x>=b.x&&a.y>=b.y&&a.x+a.w<=b.x+b.w&&a.y+a.h<=b.y+b.h;
const portFp=b=>({id:b.id,x:b.x+b.info.fp[0],y:b.y+b.info.fp[1],w:b.info.fp[2],h:b.info.fp[3]});

// ---- Floodlights and trees: placed by rule, then audited -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const PORT_LIGHTS=[],PORT_TREES=[];
{
 const roads=portRoadRects().concat([{id:'C5-PORT-DRIVE',x:3291,y:4186,w:48,h:202}]).concat(EDGES.filter(e=>/^TC-(E5|D5)-/.test(e.globalRoadId)).map(e=>{const a=_NODE_BY_ID[e.a],b=_NODE_BY_ID[e.b],h=_ROAD_HALF(e);return{id:e.id,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+h*2,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+h*2}}));
 const fps=PORT_BUILDINGS.map(portFp),sol=PORT_SOLIDS.map(s=>({x:s.x,y:s.y,w:s.w,h:s.h}));
 const clear=(x,y,m)=>{const q={x:x-m,y:y-m,w:2*m,h:2*m};return !roads.some(r=>portOver(q,r))&&!fps.some(f=>portOver(q,f))&&!sol.some(s=>portOver(q,s))&&!PORT_STALLS.some(s=>portOver(q,s))&&!PORT_RAIL_ZONES.some(z=>portOver(q,z))&&y<PORT_APRON_Y};
 const place=(x,y)=>{if(x<4800)return false;   /* S10 א: פנסי ההצפה של C6 ו-D6 — מהגיליון (021c), לא לפי הכלל הישן */if(!clear(x,y,8))return false;if(PORT_LIGHTS.some(l=>Math.hypot(l.x-x,l.y-y)<200))return false;PORT_LIGHTS.push({id:'PORT-PL-'+PORT_LIGHTS.length,asset:'SL-IND',x,y,targetWidth:24});return true};
 for(const y of[4300,4400,4520,4886])for(let x=2420;x<5990;x+=40)place(x,y);
 PORT_LIGHTS.forEach(l=>portSolid(l.id,l.x-1.5,l.y-1.5,3,3));
 const rd=PORT_LIGHTS.length;
 for(let x=2420,i=0;x<5990;x+=62,i++){
  if(roads.some(r=>x>r.x-18&&x<r.x+r.w+18&&4262>r.y-18&&4262<r.y+r.h+18))continue;
  if(PORT_RAIL_ZONES.some(z=>x>z.x-14&&x<z.x+z.w+14))continue;
  if(x>5900)continue;
  PORT_TREES.push({id:'PORT-T-'+PORT_TREES.length,asset:i%2?'TP-UR-03':'TP-UR-02',x,y:4264,targetWidth:i%2?34:30});
 }
 PORT_TREES.forEach(t=>portSolidDisc(t.id,t.x,t.y,6));
}

 function opOf(cr,t){const tt=t+cr.ph,n=Math.floor(tt/T_OP),u=(tt-n*T_OP),q=Math.floor(n/4),k=((n%4)+4)%4,r1=((q%4)+4)%4,r2=(r1+2)%4,row=k===0||k===3?r1:r2,kind=k<2?'U':'L';return{n,u,q,k,row,kind,r1,r2}}

 function stateOf(cr,t){const o=opOf(cr,t),h=BASE[cr.bay].slice(),ex=[];/* ex — המכולות שעל המקום בשורה, מלמטה: [row, tier] */

  return{o,h,ex,air}}

   if(u<2){ty=lerp(yE,yS,ease(u/2));z=zHi}else if(u<4.5){ty=yS;z=lerp(zHi,zPick,ease((u-2)/2.5))}else if(u<5.5){ty=yS;z=zPick}

// ---- Geometry audit of the three port chunks (used by the QA panel; every rule below was a real collision found while placing things) ----------------
// A road's visible width is half-width + 20 px sidewalk each side: nothing that must stay visible may stand inside it (PORT_SW).
const PORT_SW=22;

const portCraneRail=x=>PORT_CRANE_RAILS.find(r=>x>=r.x0&&x<=r.x1)||null;
function portCraneSweep(){
 let minGap=1e9,minPair='',outside=[];
 const T=Math.max(...PORT_BERTHS.map(b=>b.cycle))*2.1;
 for(let t=0;t<T;t+=1){
  const ops=portOps(t*1000),xs=PORT_CRANES.map(c=>({c,x:portCranePose(c,ops[c.berth],t*1000).x}));
  for(const q of xs){const cr=portCraneRail(q.x);if(!cr||q.x-PORT_HW-12<cr.x0+4||q.x+PORT_HW+12>cr.x1-4)outside.push(q.c.id+'@'+Math.round(q.x))}
  for(let i=0;i<xs.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<xs.length;j++){const g=Math.abs(xs[i].x-xs[j].x)-2*(PORT_HW+12);if(g<minGap){minGap=g;minPair=xs[i].c.id+'/'+xs[j].c.id}}
 }
 __opsT=-1;
 return{minGap:Math.round(minGap),minPair,outside:[...new Set(outside)].slice(0,4)};
