 function ik(ax,ay,bx,by,l1,l2,sg){let dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);const mx=l1+l2-.02;if(d>mx){bx=ax+dx/d*mx;by=ay+dy/d*mx;dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;d=mx}if(d<.01)d=.01;const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx),A=Math.acos(cl((l1*l1+d*d-l2*l2)/(2*l1*d),-1,1)),q=a+sg*A;return[ax+Math.cos(q)*l1,ay+Math.sin(q)*l1,bx,by]}
 function limb(c,x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2,w1,w2,c1,c2){c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.strokeStyle=c1;c.lineWidth=w1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y0);c.lineTo(x1,y1);c.stroke();c.strokeStyle=c2||c1;c.lineWidth=w2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x1,y1);c.lineTo(x2,y2);c.stroke()}
 /* arm presets → hand targets (screen-left 'a', screen-right 'b') in the figure's units */
 function armTargets(P,B,T){const pr=P.arms||'down',d=P.turn>=0?1:-1,sy=B.sy,ph=P.walk!=null?P.walk*TAU:0,sw=P.walk!=null?Math.sin(ph)*(P.run?9:5):0,o={};
  const down=[[-B.sw-2.2-sw*.2,sy+30],[B.sw+2.2+sw*.2,sy+30]];
  const set=(a,b)=>{o.a=a;o.b=b};
  switch(typeof pr==='string'?pr:'custom'){
   case'down':set([down[0][0]+sw*(P.turn||0),down[0][1]],[down[1][0]-sw*(P.turn||0),down[1][1]]);break;
   case'hips':set([-B.sw-6,sy+24],[B.sw+6,sy+24]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'wave':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set(down[0],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'wave2':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set([-B.sw-12-w,sy-26],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'up':set([-B.sw-6,sy-34],[B.sw+6,sy-34]);break;
   case'cheer':{const w=Math.sin(T*7)*4;set([-B.sw-9+w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)],[B.sw+9-w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)]);break}
   case'point':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-28,sy+2],d>0?[B.sw+28,sy+2]:down[1]);break;
   case'pointUp':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-12,sy-30],d>0?[B.sw+12,sy-30]:down[1]);break;
   case'chin':set(d>0?down[0]:[-2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9],d>0?[2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9]:down[1]);break;
   case'head':set([-B.sw+1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7],[B.sw-1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7]);break;
   case'clap':{const op=Math.abs(Math.sin(T*11))*5;set([-1.5-op,sy+15],[1.5+op,sy+15]);break}
   case'front':set([-5,sy+19],[5,sy+19]);break;
   case'hold':set([d*6-5,sy+16],[d*6+5,sy+16]);break;
   case'lantern':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-10,sy+14],d>0?[B.sw+10,sy+14]:down[1]);break;
   case'pull':{const k=Math.sin(T*3)*3;set([d*(16+k)-3,sy+20],[d*(26+k)+3,sy+17]);break}
   case'shrug':set([-B.sw-9,sy+9],[B.sw+9,sy+9]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'think':set(down[0],[3,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.95]);break;
   case'shade':set(down[0],[d*3+2,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.35]);break;
   case'crank':{const a=T*4.2;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*5-2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5],[d*14+Math.cos(a)*5+2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5]);break}
   case'wheel':{const a=Math.sin(T*1.6)*.5;set([d*16+Math.cos(Math.PI+a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(Math.PI+a)*8],[d*16+Math.cos(a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(a)*8]);break}
   case'radio':set(d>0?down[0]:[-4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8],d>0?[4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8]:down[1]);break;
   case'bow':set([-4,sy+34],[4,sy+34]);break;
   case'shake':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-16,sy+20],d>0?[B.sw+16,sy+20+Math.sin(T*10)*2]:down[1]);break;
   case'give':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-18,sy+10],d>0?[B.sw+18,sy+10]:down[1]);break;
   case'row':{const a=T*3;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3],[d*20+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3]);break}
   default:set(pr.a||down[0],pr.b||down[1]);o.bend=pr.bend}
  return o}
 /* the figure: feet at (x,y), s pixels per unit (a man is 100 units tall), L — the look, P — the pose */
 function fig(c,x,y,s,L,P){P=P||{};const boy=!!L.boy,B=boy?BOY:MAN,T=P.t||0,turn=cl(P.turn||0,-1,1),at=Math.abs(turn),d=turn>=0?1:-1;
  c.save();c.translate(x,y);const k=s*(L.h||(boy?.8:1));c.scale(k,k*(P.sy||1));if(P.lean)c.rotate(P.lean);
  const walking=P.walk!=null,ph=walking?P.walk*TAU:0,bob=walking?-Math.abs(Math.sin(ph))*(P.run?3.2:1.7):0,yb=(P.bob||0)+bob+(P.legs==='sit'?B.th*.92:P.legs==='kneel'?B.sh*.7:0);
  const top=L.tc||'#4a6a8a',dk=mix(top,'#000000',.32),skin=L.skin||'#d9a07a',skinD=mix(skin,'#3a2010',.28),pc=L.pc||'#2e3440',pcD=mix(pc,'#000000',.3),shoe=L.shoe||'#2a1f18';
  if(P.shadow!==false){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.28)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,15,3.2,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
  /* legs */
  const hipY=B.hip+yb,legW=B.limb[2],shW=B.limb[3],long=L.pants!=='shorts';const legs=[];
  for(const i of [0,1]){const hx0=(i?1:-1)*B.hw*.48*(1-at*.3),side=i?1:-1;let fx,fy,kn=d;
   if(P.legs==='sit'){const kx=hx0+d*B.th*Math.max(.3,at)*.95;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+2,kx+d*1.5,0]);continue}
   if(P.legs==='kneel'){if(i===(d>0?0:1)){legs.push([hx0,hipY,hx0+d*2,hipY+B.th*.95,hx0-d*B.sh*.7,-1])}else{const kx=hx0+d*B.th*.75;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+B.th*.35,kx,0])}continue}
   if(walking){const sw=(P.run?.8:.4)*Math.sin(ph+(i?Math.PI:0)),lift=Math.max(0,Math.cos(ph+(i?Math.PI:0)))*(P.run?8:4.5);fx=hx0+sw*B.th*(.25+at*.95)*d*(at>.15?1:.25);fy=-lift}
   else{const sp=P.legs==='spread'?7:P.legs==='brace'?(i?9:-9)*d:0;fx=hx0*1.15+sp*side*(P.legs==='spread'?1:0)+(P.legs==='brace'?sp:0);fy=0}
   const j=ik(hx0,hipY,fx,fy,B.th,B.sh,(i?-1:1)*-d*.0+(-d));legs.push([hx0,hipY,j[0],j[1],fx,fy])}
  const order=turn>0?[0,1]:[1,0];
  for(const i of order){const q=legs[i],far=(turn>.15&&i===0)||(turn<-.15&&i===1),col=far?pcD:pc;
   if(long){limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5]-2,legW,shW,col,col)}else{limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5]-2,legW,shW,far?skinD:skin,far?skinD:skin);c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=legW+.6;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q[0],q[1]);c.lineTo(lerp(q[0],q[2],.62),lerp(q[1],q[3],.62));c.stroke()}
   if(L.socks){c.strokeStyle=L.socks;c.lineWidth=shW*.9;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(lerp(q[2],q[4],.78),lerp(q[3],q[5],.78));c.lineTo(q[4],q[5]-2);c.stroke()}
   c.fillStyle=far?mix(shoe,'#000000',.3):shoe;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[4]+d*2.2*(.3+at),q[5]-1.6,5.2+at*1.4,2.9,0,0,TAU);c.fill();if(L.boots){c.fillRect(q[4]-3.2,q[5]-9,6.4,8)}}
  /* arms: targets, then IK */
  const AT=armTargets(P,B,T),sx=B.sw*(1-at*.28),arms=[],bw=(P.bow||0)*15;
  for(const i of [0,1]){const shx=(i?1:-1)*(sx-1.5),shy=B.sy+yb+1.5+bw,tg=i?AT.b:AT.a,tx=tg[0],ty=tg[1]+yb+bw*.6,sg=AT.bend?(i?-1:1):(i?1:-1);const j=ik(shx,shy,tx,ty,B.ua,B.fa,sg);arms.push([shx,shy,j[0],j[1],j[2],j[3]])}
  const backArm=turn>.2?0:turn<-.2?1:-1;
  const drawArm=i=>{const q=arms[i],far=i===backArm,sl=far?dk:top,sk=far?skinD:skin,short=L.top==='tee'||L.sleeves==='short';const vest=L.top==='vest'?(L.tc2||'#e9e4d8'):null,slc=vest?(far?mix(vest,'#000',.3):vest):sl;
   if(short){limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5],B.limb[0],B.limb[1]*.9,sk,sk);c.strokeStyle=slc;c.lineWidth=B.limb[0]+.8;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q[0],q[1]);c.lineTo(lerp(q[0],q[2],.55),lerp(q[1],q[3],.55));c.stroke()}
   else limb(c,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5],B.limb[0],B.limb[1],slc,slc);
   if(L.gloves){c.fillStyle=L.gloves}else c.fillStyle=sk;c.beginPath();c.arc(q[4],q[5],B.hand,0,TAU);c.fill()};
  if(backArm>=0)drawArm(backArm);
  /* the torso and the clothes */
  const sY=B.sy+yb+bw,wY=B.wy+yb+bw*.45,hY=hipY,sw=sx,ww=B.ww*(1-at*.22),hw=B.hw*(1-at*.25),long2=L.top==='raincoat'||L.top==='coat'||L.top==='firecoat'?14:0;
  const torso=()=>{c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-sw+2,sY-1.5);c.quadraticCurveTo(-sw-1,sY,-sw,sY+5);c.lineTo(-ww,wY);c.lineTo(-hw-(long2?2:0),hY+3+long2);c.lineTo(hw+(long2?2:0),hY+3+long2);c.lineTo(ww,wY);c.lineTo(sw,sY+5);c.quadraticCurveTo(sw+1,sY,sw-2,sY-1.5);c.closePath()};
  const base=L.top==='vest'?(L.tc2||'#e9e4d8'):L.top==='overall'?(L.tc2||'#e9e4d8'):top;
  torso();c.fillStyle=base;c.fill();
  c.save();torso();c.clip();
  const lx=(P.lightX==null?-.6:P.lightX),sg=c.createLinearGradient(-sw,0,sw,0);sg.addColorStop(0,lx<0?'rgba(255,255,255,.10)':'rgba(0,0,0,.22)');sg.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');sg.addColorStop(1,lx<0?'rgba(0,0,0,.24)':'rgba(255,255,255,.10)');c.fillStyle=sg;c.fillRect(-sw-3,sY-3,sw*2+6,hY-sY+20);
  const cx=turn*3.5;
  if(L.top==='vest'){c.fillStyle=top;c.fillRect(-sw-2,sY+1,sw-2.4+cx,hY-sY+4);c.fillRect(cx+2.4,sY+1,sw+2,hY-sY+4);c.fillStyle='#d9dde2';c.fillRect(-sw-2,sY+14,sw*2+4,2.2);c.fillRect(-sw-2,wY-2,sw*2+4,2.2);c.fillStyle=mix(base,'#000',.2);c.fillRect(cx-.4,sY+2,.8,hY-sY)}
  else if(L.top==='overall'){c.fillStyle=top;c.fillRect(-ww+1+cx*.5,sY+10,ww*2-2,hY-sY);c.fillRect(-sw+2.5,sY-1,3,13);c.fillRect(sw-5.5,sY-1,3,13);c.fillStyle='#d8b04a';c.beginPath();c.arc(-sw+4,sY+10,1,0,TAU);c.arc(sw-4,sY+10,1,0,TAU);c.fill()}
  else if(L.top==='jacket'||L.top==='uniform'||L.top==='coat'||L.top==='firecoat'||L.top==='raincoat'){
   if(L.top!=='raincoat'&&L.top!=='firecoat'){c.fillStyle=L.tc2||'#e8e4da';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx-4,sY-1);c.lineTo(cx+4,sY-1);c.lineTo(cx+.6,sY+15);c.lineTo(cx-.6,sY+15);c.closePath();c.fill();if(L.tie){c.fillStyle=L.tie;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx-1.2,sY+1);c.lineTo(cx+1.2,sY+1);c.lineTo(cx+1.6,sY+12);c.lineTo(cx,sY+14);c.lineTo(cx-1.6,sY+12);c.closePath();c.fill()}
    c.strokeStyle=dk;c.lineWidth=1.1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx-4.4,sY-1);c.lineTo(cx-1,sY+16);c.moveTo(cx+4.4,sY-1);c.lineTo(cx+1,sY+16);c.stroke()}
   c.strokeStyle=mix(top,'#000',.42);c.lineWidth=.8;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx,sY+15);c.lineTo(cx,hY+2+long2);c.stroke();
   c.fillStyle=L.top==='uniform'?'#e3b84a':mix(top,'#000',.45);for(let q=0;q<3;q++){c.beginPath();c.arc(cx+1.6,sY+19+q*7,.95,0,TAU);c.fill()}
   if(L.top==='uniform'){c.fillStyle='#e3b84a';c.fillRect(-sw+.5,sY,6,1.6);c.fillRect(sw-6.5,sY,6,1.6);c.beginPath();c.arc(cx-6,sY+9,1.6,0,TAU);c.fill()}
   if(L.top==='firecoat'){c.fillStyle='#e9e05a';c.fillRect(-sw-2,sY+16,sw*2+4,2.4);c.fillRect(-sw-2,hY+long2-4,sw*2+4,2.4);c.fillStyle='#d9dde2';c.fillRect(-sw-2,sY+18.4,sw*2+4,.8)}
   if(L.top==='raincoat'){c.fillStyle=mix(top,'#000',.18);for(let q=0;q<4;q++)c.fillRect(cx-1.6,sY+8+q*8,3.2,1.4);c.strokeStyle=mix(top,'#000',.3);c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,sY+1,5.5,Math.PI*.1,Math.PI*.9);c.stroke()}}
  else if(L.top==='sweater'){c.fillStyle=L.tc2||'#f2f0ea';for(let yy=sY+5;yy<hY;yy+=6)c.fillRect(-sw-2,yy,sw*2+4,2.4)}
  else if(L.top==='shirt'||L.top==='polo'){c.fillStyle=mix(top,'#ffffff',.25);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx-4.5,sY-1.5);c.lineTo(cx,sY+3);c.lineTo(cx-2.2,sY+5);c.closePath();c.fill();c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx+4.5,sY-1.5);c.lineTo(cx,sY+3);c.lineTo(cx+2.2,sY+5);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle=mix(top,'#000',.35);for(let q=0;q<(L.top==='polo'?2:4);q++){c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,sY+6+q*6,.7,0,TAU);c.fill()}if(L.top==='shirt'){c.strokeStyle=mix(top,'#000',.25);c.lineWidth=.6;c.strokeRect(cx-ww+2,sY+8,4.5,4.5)}}
  else{c.strokeStyle=mix(top,'#000',.3);c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,sY-1.5,4.2,Math.PI*.15,Math.PI*.85);c.stroke();if(L.stripe){c.fillStyle=L.stripe;c.fillRect(-sw-2,sY+12,sw*2+4,3)}if(L.num){c.fillStyle=L.stripe||'#ffffff';c.font='800 9px Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(L.num,cx,sY+24)}}
  if(L.belt!==false&&!long2&&L.top!=='overall'){c.fillStyle=mix(pc,'#000',.45);c.fillRect(-hw,hY-1.4,hw*2,2.6);c.fillStyle='#c9a95a';c.fillRect(cx-1.4,hY-1.4,2.8,2.6)}
  if(L.apron){c.fillStyle=L.apron;c.fillRect(-ww+1.5,wY-6,ww*2-3,(hY-wY)+20)}
  c.restore();
  /* the neck and the head */
  const hy=B.hy+yb+(P.nod||0)+bw*1.15,hrx=B.hr[0],hry=B.hr[1];
  c.fillStyle=skinD;c.fillRect(-2.6+turn*.8,B.neck+yb-2.5+bw,5.2,5);
  c.save();c.translate(turn*1.1,hy);if(P.tilt)c.rotate(P.tilt);
  const fx=turn*2.6;
  /* ears */
  for(const s2 of [-1,1]){if(at>.3&&s2===d)continue;c.fillStyle=skin;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(s2*hrx*(1-at*.12)-turn*1.2,.6,1.6,2.5,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=skinD;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(s2*hrx*(1-at*.12)-turn*1.2,.7,.7,1.3,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
  /* the head shape */
  c.fillStyle=skin;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-hry);c.bezierCurveTo(hrx*1.02,-hry,hrx*1.05,-hry*.15,hrx*.95,hry*.18);c.bezierCurveTo(hrx*.85,hry*.7,hrx*.38+fx*.3,hry*1.02,fx*.4,hry*1.02);c.bezierCurveTo(-hrx*.38+fx*.3,hry*1.02,-hrx*.85,hry*.7,-hrx*.95,hry*.18);c.bezierCurveTo(-hrx*1.05,-hry*.15,-hrx*1.02,-hry,0,-hry);c.fill();
  const shd=c.createLinearGradient(-hrx,0,hrx,0);shd.addColorStop(0,lx<0?'rgba(255,255,255,0)':'rgba(60,25,10,.22)');shd.addColorStop(.6,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');shd.addColorStop(1,lx<0?'rgba(60,25,10,.22)':'rgba(255,255,255,0)');c.fillStyle=shd;c.fill();
  if(at>.35){c.fillStyle=skin;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(d*hrx*.7,1);c.quadraticCurveTo(d*(hrx+1.6),1.5,d*hrx*.92,3.4);c.fill()}

  const ex=EXPR[P.expr||'n']||EXPR.n,blink=P.blink!=null?P.blink:((T*.73+((L.seed||1)*.37))%3.7<.12?1:0),eo=ex[3]*(1-blink*.92),lk=P.look||[turn*.6,0];

  for(const s2 of [-1,1]){const exx=fx+s2*2.75*(1-at*(s2===d?.15:.35)),far=at>.25&&s2!==d,ew=1.45*eyeS*(far?.72:1),eh=1.08*eyeS;
   if(eo<.2){c.strokeStyle=mix(skin,'#2a1408',.6);c.lineWidth=.55;c.beginPath();c.arc(exx,eyeY+.2,ew,Math.PI*.15,Math.PI*.85);c.stroke();continue}
   c.fillStyle='#fbf8f2';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(exx,eyeY,ew,eh*eo,0,0,TAU);c.fill();
   c.save();c.beginPath();c.ellipse(exx,eyeY,ew,eh*eo,0,0,TAU);c.clip();c.fillStyle=L.eye||'#4a2e1c';c.beginPath();c.arc(exx+lk[0]*.6,eyeY+lk[1]*.5,.92*eyeS,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#120a06';c.beginPath();c.arc(exx+lk[0]*.6,eyeY+lk[1]*.5,.46*eyeS,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#ffffff';c.beginPath();c.arc(exx+lk[0]*.6+.35,eyeY+lk[1]*.5-.38,.24*eyeS,0,TAU);c.fill();c.restore();
   c.strokeStyle=mix(skin,'#2a1408',.55);c.lineWidth=.42;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(exx,eyeY,ew,eh*eo,0,Math.PI*1.05,Math.PI*1.95);c.stroke()}
  /* brows */
  const bc=L.brow||L.hc||'#3a2a1f';c.strokeStyle=bc;c.lineWidth=boy?.85:1;c.lineCap='round';
  for(const s2 of [-1,1]){const bx=fx+s2*2.75*(1-at*.25),inner=-3.75-ex[0]*.9,outer=-3.75-ex[1]*.9;if(ex[2]==='side'&&s2===1){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(bx-s2*1.3,inner-.6);c.lineTo(bx+s2*1.6,outer-.8);c.stroke();continue}c.beginPath();c.moveTo(bx-s2*1.3,inner);c.quadraticCurveTo(bx,Math.min(inner,outer)-.5,bx+s2*1.7,outer);c.stroke()}
  /* the nose */

 function crowd(c,W,H,o){const rows=o.rows||3,t=o.t||0,R=rng(o.seed||5),lit=o.lit||'#8899aa',la=o.la==null?.5:o.la;

 function syncUi(S){const el=S.el,pb=el.querySelector('[data-ts=play]'),mb=el.querySelector('[data-ts=mute]');pb.textContent=S.playing?'⏸ עצירה':'▶ המשך';pb.setAttribute('aria-label',S.playing?'עצירה':'המשך');mb.textContent=TCSND.mute?'🔇 מושתק':'🔊 צליל';mb.setAttribute('aria-label',TCSND.mute?'ביטול השתקה':'השתקה');const v=el.querySelector('[data-ts=vol]');if(+v.value!==Math.round(TCSND.vol*100))v.value=Math.round(TCSND.vol*100)}
 function close(completed){const S=ST.on;if(!S)return;ST.on=null;ST.closed++;cancelAnimationFrame(S.raf);clearInterval(S.iv);hush(S);try{S.audio.stop()}catch(e){}try{S.el.remove()}catch(e){}

 /* D-542: the speech — each line is sent at its time (a man's or a boy's voice, fixed per character); the subtitle follows it */
 function hush(S){TCVOICE.stop();if(S&&S.lines)for(const L of S.lines)if(L.on&&!L.done){L.done=1;L.on=0}try{TCSND.duck(false)}catch(e){}}
 function voice(S,T){for(const L of S.lines){if(L.sent)continue;if(T<L.t0)break;L.sent=1;if(T>L.t1||TCSND.mute)continue;const slot=Math.max(.8,L.t1-L.t0),est=L.text.length/13,rate=est>slot*1.1?Math.min(1.35,est/slot):1;
   L.spoken=TCVOICE.speak(L.text,L.who,L.role,TCSND.vol,{t:T,rate,onstart(){L.on=1;L.ts=S.t;try{TCSND.duck(true)}catch(e){}},onend(){L.done=1;L.on=0;L.te=S.t;if(!S.lines.some(q=>q.on&&!q.done))try{TCSND.duck(false)}catch(e){}}});ST.voice.sent++;if(L.spoken)ST.voice.spoken++}}
 /* the line on the screen: a spoken line shows while it is heard (from its start to its end); a queued one waits; with no speech — by the time */
 function lineNow(S,T){let best=null;for(const L of S.lines){if(T<L.t0)break;let v;if(L.spoken){if(L.done)v=false;else if(L.on)v=true;else v=T<L.t0+1.2?false:T<L.t1}else v=T<L.t1;if(v)best=L}if(!best)return null;const a0=best.spoken&&best.ts!=null?best.ts:best.t0;return{text:best.text,b:best.b,a:Math.min(1,(T-a0)/.18,best.spoken?1:(best.t1-T)/.2)}}
 function chapter(S){const p=S.prod,ft=S.kind==='film'?S.t-PRE:S.t;if(S.kind==='film'){if(ft<0)return'האורות יורדים';if(ft>p.len)return'מחיאות כפיים';let a=0;for(const q of p.shots){if(ft<a+q.d)return q.ch||p.name;a+=q.d}return p.name}const cs=p.chapters||[];let n='';for(const q of cs)if(S.t>=q[0])n=q[1];return n}
 function loop(now){const S=ST.on;if(!S)return;const rdt=(now-S.last)/1000;S.last=now;const dt=Math.min(.1,Math.max(0,rdt));
  if(S.playing&&!S.hold){S.t+=dt;ST.frames++;ST.dts.push(rdt*1000);if(ST.dts.length>1800)ST.dts.shift();S.idleT+=dt;if(S.idleT>3.2)S.el.classList.add('idle')}
  const d0=performance.now();try{draw(S)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,400)}if(S.playing&&!S.hold){ST.dms=ST.dms||[];ST.dms.push(performance.now()-d0);if(ST.dms.length>1800)ST.dms.shift()}
  if(S.playing){S.audio.pump(S.t);voice(S,S.t)}
  if(S.warmQ&&S.warmQ.length){try{TCCITY.grab(S.warmQ.shift())}catch(e){}}
  S.el.classList.toggle('nosnd',!sndOk()&&!TCSND.mute);
  if(S.frame++%6===0){S.el.querySelector('.tsProg i').style.width=(100*Math.min(1,S.t/S.total)).toFixed(1)+'%';S.el.querySelector('.tsTime').textContent=fmt(S.t)+' / '+fmt(S.total);S.el.querySelector('.tsCh').textContent=chapter(S)}
  if(S.t>=S.total){close(true);return}
  S.raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
 /* ---------- drawing ---------- */
 function draw(S){const cv=S.cv,dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),W=cv.clientWidth||innerWidth,H=cv.clientHeight||innerHeight;if(cv.width!==Math.round(W*dpr)||cv.height!==Math.round(H*dpr)){cv.width=Math.round(W*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(H*dpr)}
  const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);if(S.kind==='film')cinema(c,W,H,S,dpr);else theatre(c,W,H,S,dpr);
  if(!S.playing){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);K.text(c,'❚❚  עצירה',W/2,H/2,Math.min(44,W/18),'#f2c45a',{stroke:'rgba(0,0,0,.7)',sw:6})}}
 function buf(S,key,w,h){let b=S[key];if(!b){b=document.createElement('canvas');S[key]=b}if(b.width!==w||b.height!==h){b.width=w;b.height=h}return b}
 const GRAIN=(()=>{let cv=null;return()=>{if(cv)return cv;cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=192;const g=cv.getContext('2d'),im=g.createImageData(192,192);for(let i=0;i<im.data.length;i+=4){const v=Math.random()*255;im.data[i]=im.data[i+1]=im.data[i+2]=v;im.data[i+3]=255}g.putImageData(im,0,0);return cv}})();
 /* the film frame: shots with cuts, dissolves and dips, then the subtitles, the grain and the vignette */
 function filmFrame(c,F,ft,S){c.fillStyle='#000';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH);if(ft<0||ft>F.len)return;let a=0,i=0;for(;i<F.shots.length;i++){if(ft<a+F.shots[i].d)break;a+=F.shots[i].d}if(i>=F.shots.length)return;const sh=F.shots[i],lt=ft-a;
  const shot=(cc,q,t)=>{cc.save();try{q.draw(cc,t,t/q.d)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,300)}cc.restore()};
  const tr=sh.tr||'cut',td=sh.td||.7;
  if(tr==='x'&&lt<td&&i>0){const prev=F.shots[i-1];shot(c,prev,prev.d+lt);const b=buf(S,'xb',c.canvas.width,c.canvas.height),bc=b.getContext('2d');bc.setTransform(c.getTransform());shot(bc,sh,lt);c.save();c.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);c.globalAlpha=K.sm(lt/td);c.drawImage(b,0,0);c.restore()}
  else shot(c,sh,lt);
  if(tr==='dip'&&lt<td){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-K.sm(lt/td))+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}
  const nx=F.shots[i+1];if(nx&&nx.tr==='dip'&&sh.d-lt<(nx.td||.7)){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+K.sm(1-(sh.d-lt)/(nx.td||.7))+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}
  if(ft<.8){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-ft/.8)+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}if(F.len-ft<1.2){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-(F.len-ft)/1.2)+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}
  const ln=S.lines?lineNow(S,S.t):null;if(ln)subtitle(c,ln.text,FW/2,FH-40,Math.max(0,ln.a),ln.b?'b':'')}
 function subtitle(c,txt,x,y,al,who){const Z=typeof TCSET!=='undefined'?TCSET.subsScale():1;if(!Z)return;   /* 10.11 (opening): הכתוביות — מסך ההגדרות (כבויות / רגיל / גדול) */c.save();c.globalAlpha=al;if(Z!==1){c.translate(x,y);c.scale(Z,Z);x=0;y=0}c.font='700 29px "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif';c.direction='rtl';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';const w=c.measureText(txt).width;c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.5)';const p=16;if(c.roundRect){c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x-w/2-p,y-22,w+p*2,44,10);c.fill()}else c.fillRect(x-w/2-p,y-22,w+p*2,44);c.lineJoin='round';c.lineWidth=5;c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.85)';c.strokeText(txt,x,y);c.fillStyle=who==='b'?'#ffe9a8':'#ffffff';c.fillText(txt,x,y);c.restore()}
 /* the reactions of the hall: [[t,dur],..] → 0..1 */
 function env(list,t){let v=0;for(const [a,d] of list||[]){const u=(t-a)/d;if(u>=0&&u<=1)v=Math.max(v,Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,u*1.6))*(u<.85?1:(1-u)/.15))}return v}
 /* ---------- the cinema ---------- */
 function cinema(c,W,H,S,dpr){const F=S.prod,T=S.t,ft=T-PRE,E=PRE+F.len,house=T<PRE?1-K.sm(T/2.6)*.94:T>E?.06+K.sm((T-E-1)/2.5)*.9:.06,cur=T<PRE?K.sm((T-1.8)/2.6):T>E?1-K.sm((T-E-1.2)/2.8):1;
  const sw=Math.min(W*.92,H*.64*FW/FH),sh=sw*FH/FW,sx=(W-sw)/2,sy=Math.max(10,H*.06);
  /* the walls, the panels and the sconces: drawn once per size and light level (a cached canvas), lit by the screen on top */
  const hq=Math.round(house*20)/20,bg=K.cached('hall|'+W+'x'+H+'|'+hq+'|'+dpr,W*dpr,H*dpr,(g)=>{g.scale(dpr,dpr);const wall=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);wall.addColorStop(0,K.mix('#0e0a14','#3a2430',hq));wall.addColorStop(1,K.mix('#040306','#24141c',hq));g.fillStyle=wall;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   for(const s of [-1,1]){const x0=s<0?0:W,pw=Math.max(0,(W-sw)/2-14);if(pw<20)continue;for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const px=s<0?x0+pw*(k+.5)/3:x0-pw*(k+.5)/3,py=sy+sh*.35;g.strokeStyle=K.rgba('#c9a24a',.25+hq*.4);g.lineWidth=1.5;g.strokeRect(px-pw/7,sy+10,pw/3.5,H*.62);
    g.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#d9b45a',hq);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(px-9,py);g.lineTo(px+9,py);g.lineTo(px+5,py+16);g.lineTo(px-5,py+16);g.closePath();g.fill();K.glow(g,px,py+4,70*(.3+hq),'#ffcf8a',.15+hq*.55);K.glow(g,px,py-30,90,'#ffcf8a',hq*.18)}}
   for(const x of [W*.04,W*.96]){if(W<700)break;g.fillStyle='#0d3b1f';g.fillRect(x-30,H*.5,60,20);K.text(g,'יציאה',x,H*.5+10,13,'#6bff9a',{w:700,glow:'#2aff6a',gb:8})}
   g.fillStyle='#030204';g.fillRect(sx-14,sy-12,sw+28,sh+24)});
  c.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);const sc=S.scr,lum=S.lum*(ft>0&&ft<F.len?1:0);if(lum>.02){c.fillStyle=K.rgba(sc,.07*lum);c.fillRect(sx-40,sy-30,sw+80,sh+60)}
  /* the screen: the masking, the film (or the closed curtain) */
  c.save();c.translate(sx,sy);c.scale(sw/FW,sh/FH);c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,FW,FH);c.clip();filmFrame(c,F,ft,S);
  if(ft>0&&ft<F.len){const g=c.createRadialGradient(FW/2,FH/2,FH*.42,FW/2,FH/2,FW*.62);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.42)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}c.restore();
  if(T<PRE+.4){c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#d6cdbd',house*.65);c.fillRect(sx,sy,sw,sh)}
  if(S.frame%30===0&&ft>0&&ft<F.len){try{const sm=buf(S,'smp',6,2),g=sm.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});g.drawImage(c.canvas,sx*dpr,sy*dpr,sw*dpr,sh*dpr,0,0,6,2);const d=g.getImageData(0,0,6,2).data;let r=0,gg=0,b=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){r+=d[i];gg+=d[i+1];b+=d[i+2]}const n=d.length/4;r/=n;gg/=n;b/=n;S.lum=(r*.3+gg*.59+b*.11)/255;const m=Math.max(r,gg,b,1);S.scr='#'+[r,gg,b].map(v=>Math.round(Math.min(255,v/m*230)).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}catch(e){}}
  /* the projector's light over the heads */
  if(ft>0&&ft<F.len){c.save();const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,H,0,sy+sh);g.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(sc,0));g.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(sc,.05+lum*.07));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(W/2-30,H+40);c.lineTo(W/2+30,H+40);c.lineTo(sx+sw,sy+sh);c.lineTo(sx,sy+sh);c.closePath();c.fill();const R=K.rng(4);for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const u=(R()+T*.01*(R()+.2))%1,px=K.lerp(W/2,sx+R()*sw,u),py=K.lerp(H,sy+sh,u)+Math.sin(T*.6+i)*6;c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#ffffff',.18*R()*(.3+lum));c.fillRect(px,py,1.5,1.5)}c.restore()}
  /* the curtain: the valance, and two halves that slide to the sides */
  curtainPair(c,sx-14,sy-12,sw+28,sh+24,cur,house,T);
  /* the audience: men and boys, lit by the screen; they laugh, lean in, clap at the end */
  const laugh=ft>0?env(F.react&&F.react.laugh,ft):0,lean=ft>0?env(F.react&&F.react.lean,ft):0,clap=T>E+.1&&T<E+4.6?1:0;
  c.save();c.translate(0,0);K.crowd(c,W,H+20,{rows:3,rowH:H*.085,n:Math.max(7,Math.round(W/120)),scale:Math.max(.7,Math.min(1.5,H/620)),t:T,lit:sc,la:.2+lum*.55,laugh,lean,clap,clapHigh:1,seat:'#2a0710',seed:9,dim:(1-house)*.72});c.restore();
  if(S.snack){c.save();c.translate(W-90,H-10);popcorn(c,1.1*Math.min(1.4,H/620),K.rgba(sc,.4))}
}
 function popcorn(c,s,lit){c.scale(s,s);c.fillStyle='#f4f0e6';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-34,-110);c.lineTo(34,-110);c.lineTo(26,0);c.lineTo(-26,0);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle='#c0392b';for(let i=0;i<4;i++){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-34+i*17+4,-110);c.lineTo(-34+i*17+12,-110);c.lineTo(-26+i*13+9,0);c.lineTo(-26+i*13+3,0);c.closePath();c.fill()}const R=K.rng(3);for(let i=0;i<26;i++){c.fillStyle=i%3?'#fff3c8':'#f7d98a';c.beginPath();c.arc(-30+R()*60,-112-R()*18,6+R()*3,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}c.strokeStyle=lit;c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-34,-110);c.lineTo(-26,0);c.stroke();c.restore()}
 function curtainTex(w,h,col){return K.cached('cur|'+Math.round(w)+'|'+Math.round(h)+'|'+col,w,h,(g,W,H)=>{const n=Math.max(8,Math.round(W/34));for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=i*W/n,gr=g.createLinearGradient(x,0,x+W/n,0);gr.addColorStop(0,K.mix(col,'#000000',.55));gr.addColorStop(.45,K.mix(col,'#ffffff',.08));gr.addColorStop(.6,col);gr.addColorStop(1,K.mix(col,'#000000',.55));g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x,0,W/n+1,H)}const v=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);v.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.35)');v.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');v.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.25)');g.fillStyle=v;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.fillStyle='#d9a93b';for(let x=0;x<W;x+=7)g.fillRect(x,H-10,3.5,10);g.fillStyle='#b8861e';g.fillRect(0,H-12,W,3)})}
 function curtainPair(c,x,y,w,h,open,house,T){const half=w/2,cw=half*(1-open*.94),tex=curtainTex(half,h,'#7a1426'),sway=Math.sin(T*.8)*2*(open>0&&open<1?3:1);
  if(cw>2){for(const s of [-1,1]){c.save();c.beginPath();if(s<0)c.rect(x,y,cw+sway,h);else c.rect(x+w-cw-sway,y,cw+sway,h);c.clip();c.drawImage(tex,s<0?x-(half-cw)+sway:x+w-cw-sway,y,half,h);c.restore()}
   K.glow(c,x+w/2,y+h,h*.9,'#ffb070',.12+house*.25)}
  const vh=Math.max(18,h*.09);c.fillStyle='#5a0d1c';c.fillRect(x-10,y-vh*.6,w+20,vh);c.fillStyle='#7a1426';for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const sx2=x-10+(w+20)*i/14,sw2=(w+20)/14;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(sx2,y+vh*.4);c.quadraticCurveTo(sx2+sw2/2,y+vh*1.2,sx2+sw2,y+vh*.4);c.fill()}c.fillStyle='#d9a93b';c.fillRect(x-10,y+vh*.35,w+20,2.5)}
 /* ---------- the theatre ---------- */
 function theatre(c,W,H,S,dpr){const P=S.prod,T=S.t,Kf=(k,d)=>k?K.kf(k,T)[0]:d,house=Kf(P.house,.08),cur=Kf(P.curtain,1),stage=Kf(P.stage,1),bpm=P.bpm||90;
  const pw=Math.min(W*.8,H*.6*SW/SH),ph=pw*SH/SW,px=(W-pw)/2,py=Math.max(H*.12,46);
  /* the house: red walls, gold pilasters, boxes with an audience, chandeliers */
  const wall=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);wall.addColorStop(0,K.mix('#1a0a10','#5a1c26',house));wall.addColorStop(1,K.mix('#0a0406','#2a0c12',house));c.fillStyle=wall;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  K.glow(c,W/2,py+ph*.6,Math.max(W,H)*.6,'#ffcf8a',.05+stage*.12);
  for(const s of [-1,1]){const bx=s<0?px*.5:W-px*.5,bw=px*.78;if(bw<40)continue;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const by=py+ph*(.18+k*.42),bh=ph*.3;c.fillStyle=K.mix('#2a0a12','#6a1e2a',house*.6+stage*.2);c.fillRect(bx-bw/2,by,bw,bh);c.fillStyle='#c9a24a';c.fillRect(bx-bw/2,by+bh-8,bw,4);
    const R=K.rng(k*7+(s>0?3:1));for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const hx2=bx-bw/2+bw*(i+.5)/3,hy=by+bh-16,sc2=bw/150;c.fillStyle='#120a0c';c.beginPath();c.arc(hx2,hy-6*sc2,7*sc2,0,K.TAU);c.fill();c.fillRect(hx2-10*sc2,hy,20*sc2,10*sc2);c.strokeStyle=K.rgba('#ffcf8a',.25*stage);c.lineWidth=1.5;c.beginPath();c.arc(hx2,hy-6*sc2,7*sc2,Math.PI*1.1,Math.PI*1.6);c.stroke()}
    c.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#ffe0a0',house);c.beginPath();c.arc(bx,by-10,4,0,K.TAU);c.fill();K.glow(c,bx,by-10,40,'#ffcf8a',house*.6)}}
  for(const x of [W*.18,W*.82]){K.glow(c,x,H*.05,120,'#ffe6b0',house*.55);c.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#fff0c8',house);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){c.beginPath();c.arc(x-30+i*10,H*.04+Math.abs(i-3)*3,2.4,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}}
  /* the stage */
  c.save();c.translate(px,py);c.scale(pw/SW,ph/SH);c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,SW,SH);c.clip();c.fillStyle='#050305';c.fillRect(0,0,SW,SH);
  S.spots=[];try{P.draw(c,T,S)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,300)}
  c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-stage)+')';c.fillRect(0,0,SW,SH);
  c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';for(const q of S.spots){const a=(q.a==null?.5:q.a)*stage;if(a<=0)continue;const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,q.y);g.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',a*.05));g.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',a*.22));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q.x+(q.sx||0)-14,-10);c.lineTo(q.x+(q.sx||0)+14,-10);c.lineTo(q.x+q.r,q.y);c.lineTo(q.x-q.r,q.y);c.closePath();c.fill();const e=c.createRadialGradient(q.x,q.y,2,q.x,q.y,q.r*1.2);e.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',a*.5));e.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',0));c.fillStyle=e;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q.x,q.y,q.r*1.2,q.r*.28,0,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}c.restore();
  /* the main curtain: it rises */

   if(!ok){if(o.fallback)o.fallback(c,t,u);else{K.sky(c,0,0,FW,FH,o.hour||12,0)}}else grade(c,o.grade,t);if(o.over)o.over(c,t,u)}};return q}

/* ===== D-542 (8.11) · TCVOICE — every line of dialogue is spoken aloud in Hebrew by the browser's speech (as the voice message of the phone, g77SpPlay):
   men's and boys' voices only — a male Hebrew voice by its name when there is one, else the same voice lowered; one fixed voice per character.
   The subtitle follows the speech (it shows when the line starts and changes when it ends); the music goes down under the speech; mute and volume rule it.
   With no Hebrew speech in the browser — the subtitles alone, and the show keeps its time.
   TCCITY — the real city in the films and on the stage: the game's own renderer draws the world at the scene's camera (render() into #game, under the show),
   and the shot copies it into the frame — the real E3 roof, the port and its cranes, the power plant, the marina, the airfield, the trains and the buses. ===== */
var TCVOICE=(function(){
 const st={sent:0,started:0,ended:0,errors:0,cancels:0,voices:0,he:0,last:null,log:[]};
 const MALE=/asaf|avri|ronen|david|yossi|אסף|אברי|\bmale\b|standard-b|standard-d|wavenet-b|wavenet-d|neural2-b|neural2-d/i,FEMALE=/carmit|hila|michal|כרמית|הילה|מיכל|female|standard-a|standard-c|wavenet-a|wavenet-c|neural2-a|neural2-c/i;
 let he=[];
 function load(){try{if(!window.speechSynthesis)return;const all=speechSynthesis.getVoices()||[];st.voices=all.length;he=all.filter(v=>/^he|^iw/i.test(v.lang||'')||/hebrew|עברית/i.test(v.name||''));st.he=he.length}catch(e){}}
 try{if(window.speechSynthesis){load();speechSynthesis.addEventListener?speechSynthesis.addEventListener('voiceschanged',load):(speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=load)}}catch(e){}
 const ok=()=>{if(!he.length)load();return !!(window.speechSynthesis&&typeof SpeechSynthesisUtterance==='function'&&he.length)};
 const hash=s=>{let h=7;for(const ch of String(s))h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return h};
 /* a fixed voice for a character: role 'b' — a boy, 'o' — an old man, else a man */
 function voiceOf(who,role){const males=he.filter(v=>MALE.test(v.name)&&!FEMALE.test(v.name)),neutral=he.filter(v=>!FEMALE.test(v.name)),pool=males.length?males:neutral.length?neutral:he,lowered=!males.length,h=hash(who||role||'x'),j=((h>>>4)%5-2)*.04;
  /* 8.11 (D‑552, הבעלים: "לכל שחקן קול אחר, ולילד סגנון ילד ולסבא סגנון סבא"; בבדיקה ב-Edge: אסף מקומי ואברי ברשת): כשיש שני קולות גבריים ומעלה —
     נער: הקול המקומי (הגובה משתנה בו היטב) גבוה ומהיר; סבא: הקול הטבעי, איטי; גבר: לפי הדמות — כל דמות קול קבוע מתוך כל הקולות הגבריים */
  const local=pool.filter(v=>v.localService),online=pool.filter(v=>!v.localService);let v,pitch,rate;
  if(!lowered&&pool.length>1){if(role==='b'){v=(local[0]||pool[0]);pitch=1.38+j;rate=1.12}else if(role==='o'){v=(online[0]||pool[pool.length-1]);pitch=.86+j/2;rate=.84}else{v=pool[h%pool.length];pitch=1+j;rate=1}}
  else if(!lowered){v=pool[h%pool.length];pitch=role==='b'?1.36+j:role==='o'?.72+j/2:.96+j;rate=role==='o'?.86:role==='b'?1.1:1}
  else{v=pool[h%pool.length];pitch=role==='b'?.95+j:role==='o'?.42+j/2:.55+j;rate=role==='o'?.88:role==='b'?1.08:1}
  return{v,pitch:Math.max(.1,Math.min(2,pitch)),rate}}
 /* speak one line; cb: onstart/onend; returns false when there is no Hebrew speech */
 function speak(text,who,role,vol,cb){if(!ok())return false;try{const q=voiceOf(who,role),rate=q.rate*(cb&&cb.rate||1),V=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,vol));
   /* 8.11 (D‑552, הבעלים: "שיעבוד טוב גם בכרום"): שורה ארוכה — מתחלקת למשפטים קצרים שנאמרים ברצף (כרום קוטע לפעמים משפט ארוך);
      onstart — בתחילת הראשון, onend — בסוף האחרון בלבד, כך שהכתובית מתחלפת רק כשהשורה כולה נגמרה */
   const parts=String(text).length>150?String(text).split(/(?<=[.!?…:;])\s+/).reduce((a,s)=>{if(a.length&&(a[a.length-1]+' '+s).length<=150)a[a.length-1]+=' '+s;else a.push(s);return a},[]):[String(text)];
   let k=0,done=false;const fin=e=>{if(done)return;done=true;st.ended++;cb&&cb.onend&&cb.onend(e)};
   const one=()=>{const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(parts[k]);u.lang='he-IL';try{if(q.v)u.voice=q.v}catch(e){}u.pitch=q.pitch;u.rate=rate;u.volume=V;
     if(k===0)u.onstart=()=>{st.started++;cb&&cb.onstart&&cb.onstart()};
     u.onend=()=>{k++;if(k<parts.length&&!done)one();else fin()};u.onerror=e=>{st.errors++;fin(e)};speechSynthesis.speak(u)};
   one();st.sent++;st.last=text;if(st.log.length<300)st.log.push([+(cb&&cb.t||0).toFixed(2),who||'',String(text).length,q.v&&q.v.name||'',+q.pitch.toFixed(2),parts.length]);return true}catch(e){st.errors++;return false}}
 function stop(){try{if(window.speechSynthesis){speechSynthesis.cancel();st.cancels++}}catch(e){}}
 function pause(){try{window.speechSynthesis&&speechSynthesis.pause()}catch(e){}}
 function resume(){try{window.speechSynthesis&&speechSynthesis.resume()}catch(e){}}
 function reset(){st.sent=st.started=st.ended=st.errors=0;st.log=[]}
 return{st,ok,speak,stop,pause,resume,reset,voiceOf,load,get he(){return he}}})();
var TCCITY=(function(){
 const st={n:0,ms:0,max:0,err:null,warm:0};
 /* draw the world at the camera {x,y,z,night} into the game's canvas (it is under the show), restore everything, and return the canvas */
 function grab(cam){const g=document.getElementById('game');if(!g||typeof render!=='function'||typeof Camera==='undefined')return null;const C=Camera,sx=C.x,sy=C.y,sz=C.zoom,sq=State.mapQa,sn=window.__TC_NIGHT,t0=performance.now();let ap=false;
  try{C.x=cam.x;C.y=cam.y;C.zoom=cam.z;State.mapQa=true;if(cam.night!=null)window.__TC_NIGHT=cam.night;try{simInterpApply(SIM_LOOP.alpha,SIM_LOOP.alphaW);ap=true}catch(e){}
   render(SIM_LOOP.renderNow+(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined'?SIM_BENCH_OFS:0))}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,200)}
  finally{if(ap)try{simInterpRestore()}catch(e){}C.x=sx;C.y=sy;C.zoom=sz;State.mapQa=sq;window.__TC_NIGHT=sn}
  const ms=performance.now()-t0;st.n++;st.ms+=(ms-st.ms)*.1;st.max=Math.max(st.max,ms);return g}
 /* the city as a shot: covers the rect (0,0,w,h) of the context; cam.x/y — the centre in the world, cam.z — the game's zoom */
 function shot(c,cam,w,h){const g=grab(cam);if(!g||!g.width)return false;const gw=g.width,gh=g.height,sa=w/h,ga=gw/gh;let sw=gw,sh=gh,ox=0,oy=0;if(ga>sa){sw=gh*sa;ox=(gw-sw)/2}else{sh=gw/sa;oy=(gh-sh)/2}c.drawImage(g,ox,oy,sw,sh,0,0,w,h);return true}
 /* the tiles of a place are built over a few frames: visit the cameras of a show before it needs them */
 function warm(cams){for(const q of cams){grab(q);st.warm++}}
 /* a live view: the world is drawn into a buffer at a fixed camera (15 times a second), and the shot moves inside it at the full frame rate.
    v = {x,y,span}: the centre of the view in the world and the width of the world it shows */
 const B={};
 function live(key,cam,every){let b=B[key];const now=performance.now();if(!b)b=B[key]={cv:document.createElement('canvas'),t:0};
  if(now-b.t>Math.max(every||66,st.ms*6.5)){const g=grab(cam);   /* adaptive: the world takes at most about a sixth of the time */if(g&&g.width){if(b.cv.width!==g.width||b.cv.height!==g.height){b.cv.width=g.width;b.cv.height=g.height}b.cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(g,0,0);b.t=now;b.cam={...cam};b.cw=g.clientWidth||innerWidth}}return b}
 function view(c,key,cam,v,w,h,every){const b=live(key,cam,every);if(!b.t)return false;const gw=b.cv.width,gh=b.cv.height,k=gw/b.cw*b.cam.z,sw=Math.min(gw,v.span*k),sh=Math.min(gh,sw*h/w);let sx=(v.x-b.cam.x)*k+gw/2-sw/2,sy=(v.y-b.cam.y)*k+gh/2-sh/2;sx=Math.max(0,Math.min(gw-sw,sx));sy=Math.max(0,Math.min(gh-sh,sy));c.drawImage(b.cv,sx,sy,sw,sh,0,0,w,h);return true}
 /* the camera that covers a path of views: [[t,x,y,span],..] */
 function camFor(keys,w,h,night){let x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y0=1e9,y1=-1e9,sp=0;for(const q of keys){x0=Math.min(x0,q[1]);x1=Math.max(x1,q[1]);y0=Math.min(y0,q[2]);y1=Math.max(y1,q[2]);sp=Math.max(sp,q[3])}const W=x1-x0+sp,H=y1-y0+sp*h/w;return{x:(x0+x1)/2,y:(y0+y1)/2,z:Math.min(innerWidth/W,innerHeight/H)*.98,night}}
 const ok=()=>typeof render==='function'&&!!document.getElementById('game');
 return{st,grab,shot,warm,ok,live,view,camFor,B}})();

var TCVOICETEST=(function(){
 const E=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'})[c]);

 function report(){const {all,he}=list(),P=pick(),ua=navigator.userAgent||'';
  const br=/Edg\//.test(ua)?'Edge':/Chrome\//.test(ua)?'Chrome':/Firefox\//.test(ua)?'Firefox':/Safari\//.test(ua)?'Safari':'אחר';
